You will own specific product areas end to end, write detailed requirements, drive sprint-level delivery, and ensure that AI products meet well-defined quality and safety standards before reaching customers. You will also engage with customers and internal product teams to ground your decisions in real-world use cases.


Roles and Responsibilities

- Own and execute the product roadmap for assigned areas of the AI platform, including the ingestion and context layer, orchestration layer, agent framework components, and the Copilot experience across all product lines.
- Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI features, and drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and delivery tracking in close partnership with engineering and machine learning teams.
- Define and maintain the evaluation framework for assigned AI features including offline evals, benchmark metrics, regression tests, and production monitoring. No agent or model capability ships without defined success criteria.
- Own the responsible AI execution process at the feature level, including guardrail testing, safety checklists, bias review, and auditability verification before any AI capability reaches customers.
- Serve as the internal AI platform expert for Senior Product Managers across all product lines, providing guidance on how to correctly integrate, specify, and evaluate AI capabilities within their respective workflows.
- Contribute to the model management and MCP server roadmap by gathering data on provider performance, cost, and quality, and by identifying integration opportunities and validating tool specifications.
- Engage with enterprise customers to gather feedback on AI feature performance, understand adoption patterns, and translate insights into roadmap decisions.
- Monitor the competitive landscape for relevant AI product developments, agent frameworks, and enterprise AI tooling, and bring insights into prioritization discussions.


Soft Skills

- Technically credible with engineering and data science teams. Can engage substantively on prompt design, evaluation tradeoffs, RAG configurations, and agent behavior without needing to write code.
- Clear and precise communicator. Able to write requirements, specs, and documentation that engineering teams can act on without repeated clarification.
- Customer empathy. Listens carefully to enterprise customer feedback and translates nuanced qualitative input into actionable product decisions.
- High ownership mindset. Takes accountability for feature quality, safety, and customer outcomes, not just delivery of scope.
- Structured problem-solver. Breaks ambiguous AI product challenges into well-defined hypotheses, experiments, and evaluation plans.
- Stays current with fast-moving developments in foundation models, agentic architectures, and enterprise AI deployment patterns.


Hard Skills

- Strong understanding of the AI product development lifecycle including data pipelines, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, fine-tuning, and agentic system design.
- Experience designing and running AI evaluation frameworks including offline evals, human evaluation pipelines, and production monitoring for AI features.
- Familiarity with responsible AI principles including human-in-the-loop design, fairness considerations, auditability, and guardrail implementation in enterprise settings.
- Working knowledge of model context protocol or equivalent tool-use and integration frameworks for agentic systems.
- Ability to define and track AI-specific product metrics including task completion rates, hallucination rates, model latency, cost per inference, and user satisfaction signals.


Technical Skills

- Familiarity with major foundation model providers and the practical tradeoffs among them in terms of capability, cost, latency, context window, and data privacy.
- Working knowledge of vector databases, semantic search, and embedding-based retrieval systems relevant to RAG product design.
- Familiarity with AI evaluation tooling such as LLM eval libraries, RAGAS, or equivalent frameworks for measuring AI system performance.
- Understanding of AI orchestration patterns including ReAct loops, multi-agent coordination, and durable workflow execution for long-running agent tasks.
- Proficiency with standard product management tools alongside AI-specific development and observability platforms.


Educational Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. Advanced degree in a relevant discipline is an advantage.


Prior Experience

- 7 to 10 years of experience in product management, with at least 2 to 3 years owning AI or machine learning product features in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
- Demonstrated experience shipping AI features to production in enterprise contexts, including agents, copilots, predictive models, or recommendation systems.
- Hands-on experience defining evaluation criteria and running evals for AI features, including benchmark design, human evaluation coordination, and production quality tracking.
- Experience working directly with data science and machine learning engineering teams on model prototyping, prompt iteration, or deployment workflows.
- Background in infrastructure, construction, capital program management, or other complex enterprise domains is a strong advantage.


About Aurigo
Aurigo provides AI-native platforms that help capital owners connect planning, construction, and operations in a single environment, improving decision-making and execution. Trusted by over 300 organizations across federal, state, and local government, manufacturing, data centers, energy and utilities, and life sciences, we manage more than $450 billion in capital programs across 40,000+ projects in North America. Built on 20+ years of domain expertise, Aurigo has received multiple industry awards and has been certified as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years.


At Aurigo, we go beyond building technology—we shape the future. If you're excited to join a fast-growing company and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry to solve real-world challenges, let's connect.

title: Product Lead
descriptionHtml:
Product Lead - Backend & Platform Engineering

LaFetch is India’s freshest fashion destination, a curated marketplace for the coolest homegrown brands, delivered in 60 minutes across Delhi NCR.

We’re building the future of fashion commerce where discovery, culture, content, and technology come together seamlessly.

We’re now looking for a Product Lead who can own both product thinking and backend system, someone who understands how to build scalable technology while shaping intuitive consumer experiences.

This is a high-impact role for someone excited about solving product, platform, and engineering challenges at a fast-moving fashion-tech startup.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a highly ownership-driven Product Lead with strong backend engineering capabilities to lead the evolution of LaFetch’s digital product ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, backend architecture, platform scalability, and customer experience. You’ll own the end-to-end lifecycle of key product initiatives while actively collaborating on backend systems, APIs, integrations, infrastructure, and platform performance.

You’ll work closely with engineering, design, marketing, operations, and founders to build scalable systems and seamless user experiences across web and mobile platforms.

This is not a traditional corporate PM role. We want someone who can think strategically, move fast operationally, and deeply understand how product decisions connect with technical architecture.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Product Ownership & Strategy

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of key product features across web and mobile platforms, from discovery and roadmap planning to launch and iteration.
  • Define product priorities aligned with business goals, operational scalability, and customer behavior insights.
  • Drive experimentation and rapid feature launches with a strong bias toward action.

Backend & Platform Engineering

  • Build, maintain, and optimize backend services powering LaFetch’s web, app, operational systems, and integrations.
  • Design scalable APIs and backend architecture for high-performance consumer experiences.
  • Work with SQL databases, GraphQL, and API-first systems to support scale, reliability, and speed.
  • Collaborate on backend frameworks using Node.js, Spring Boot, and cloud infrastructure.

Customer Experience & UX Collaboration

  • Partner with product design and UX teams to create intuitive, discovery-first, and high-conversion shopping experiences.
  • Translate customer pain points and behavioral insights into scalable technical and product solutions.

Omni-Channel Product Systems

  • Build seamless integrations across service providers, operational tools, delivery systems, and LaFetch’s digital ecosystem.
  • Ensure smooth customer journeys across browsing, checkout, delivery, and post-purchase experiences.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, frontend, design, marketing, operations, and leadership teams to align execution with business priorities.
  • Act as a bridge between product vision and technical implementation.

Infrastructure & Scalability

  • Manage deployments and environments across AWS, Oracle, Azure, or similar cloud platforms.
  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, security, and backend performance optimization.
  • Maintain strong version control and engineering practices using Git/GitHub.

Data-Driven Product Decisions

  • Use analytics, dashboards, A/B testing, and user behavior data to drive product improvements and prioritization.
  • Define KPIs and monitor feature adoption, conversion, retention, and operational efficiency.

Tech & Trend Awareness

  • Stay updated on emerging technologies, Gen Z commerce trends, AI-enabled product experiences, and modern digital infrastructure practices.
  • Continuously bring innovative thinking into the product and engineering roadmap.


Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience building and scaling consumer-facing digital products, preferably in fashion eCommerce, marketplaces, retail-tech, or high-growth startups.
  • Strong backend engineering experience with Node.js, Spring Boot, APIs, SQL, GraphQL, and scalable backend systems.
  • Strong understanding of product frameworks, agile methodologies, user journey mapping, and platform architecture.
  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Oracle, or Azure.
  • Comfortable using tools such as Figma, GA4, SQL, Git/GitHub, and analytics platforms.
  • Strong understanding of API-first architecture, backend security, and scalable systems design.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • High ownership mindset with a bias toward experimentation, speed, and execution.
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced startup environments with evolving priorities.


Bonus Points If You

  • Have worked in fashion-tech, commerce, logistics, quick commerce, or discovery-led consumer platforms.
  • Have experience building scalable systems for high-growth consumer apps.
  • Understand Gen Z internet behavior, discovery commerce, and content-driven shopping experiences.
  • Have worked in 0→1 startup environments building products from scratch.


Why Join LaFetch?

  • Build systems and product experiences used daily by thousands of shoppers and brands.
  • Directly influence the future of fashion-tech in India.
  • High ownership with real product and technical decision-making power.
  • Startup speed, ideas turn into shipped features fast.
  • Work closely with founders and core teams shaping the company’s growth.
  • Creative, ambitious, and culture-first work environment.


The Basics

  • Full-time onsite role based in Gurgaon, Delhi NCR.
  • 5-day work week.
  • Fast-paced startup environment with high ownership and rapid execution.


If this sounds like you, send your GitHub, portfolio, or projects at ishita@la-fetch.com

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Overview

Lead the vision and execution for next-generation agentic AI products—designing generative experiences across search, chat and other agentic experiences. As a Principal Product Manager (PM) for the Search & AI team, you’ll architect solutions that reason, plan, and act across applications, the web, and the OS, empowering users to accomplish complex tasks with intelligence and reliability.

You’ll join a high-impact team that uses the cutting edge of generative model and applies to high-value product experiences across Search and Copilot. Search & AI Experiences team thrives on rapid innovation, cross-functional collaboration, and a culture that values curiosity, autonomy, and bold problem-solving. We work across a range of experiences spanning from user intent understanding, semantic understanding of queries and documents, vector-based information retrieval, generating card answers and user experiences and generative query suggestions. We also work on leading edge of Responsible AI techniques to ensure high quality user interactions. We seek PMs who have shipped 0-to-1 agentic products at leading AI startups or labs, great product sense and user experience instincts, driven growth or mindshare in the AI space, and excel in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

If you’re energized by building the future of generative AI experiences and want to shape how intelligent agents empower millions, we want to hear from you!

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50-mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

As a Principal Product Manager, you will:

  • Define and deliver on the strategicroadmap and vision across multiple initiatives.
  • Identify user workflows where AI adds clear value, basing decisions on data and user feedback.
  • Turn model capabilities into specific product features, define MVPs, and refine them using user and business metrics.
  • Work directly with applied science, engineering, and design to turn AI research into practical products that scale and serve users well.
  • Create and use evaluation methods to track product quality, user experience, and safety throughout development.
  • Write clear documents to keep stakeholders aligned on product goals, priorities, and decisions.
  • Promote adoption by representing Microsoft AI at industry events, showing how technical features translate into user benefits and growth.
  • Make informed decisions in uncertain situations, manage risks and incidents, and support continuous improvement through postmortem review.
  • Be the thought-leader for driving DAU growth across teams.
  • Prioritize features to maximize DAU growth – build and partner with feature teams.
  • Envision and implement distribution tactics for the product growth– these include cross org execution of entry points, external partnerships for mobile & desktop DAU and other growth hacks.
  • Create win-win partnership pitches and evolve strategic partnerships to drive growth across industry and research labs.
  • Manage, implement and deliver cross-org growth initiatives through collaboration & evangelism.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
    • OR equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience launching 0-to-1 products (from concept to market) in a consumer-facing product environment.
  • 3+ years of experience building products that leverage AI/ML technologies.
  • Experience managing and shipping products in an AI lab or an AI-focused startup.
  • Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, research) to deliver user-facing features.
  • Familiarity with experimentation tools, data analytics, and strong in vibe coding / working knowledge of coding (Python, JavaScript, SQL).
  • Excellent analytical, communication, presentation and negotiation skills with cross-functional organizations, customers and stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, possesses a high energy level to react to situations quickly and decisively, possessing self-confidence to be assertive when taking a position, not afraid to make decisions.
  • Passionate & capable of driving cross-functional initiatives – product features, distribution tactics & partnerships.
  • Demonstrated expertise in growing consumer products of large scale globally.

#MicrosoftAI

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager – Web & Apps

Location: Mumbai

Company: Pinkvilla Media Pvt. Ltd.


About Pinkvilla

Pinkvilla is one of India’s leading digital media platforms covering entertainment, lifestyle, and pop culture, reaching millions of users across web and mobile apps. We are building the next generation of content experiences driven by product, data, and innovation.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to work on the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Pinkvilla’s website and mobile applications (iOS & Android). This role requires a strong mix of consumer product thinking, data-driven decision-making, and execution excellence to enhance user engagement, retention, and monetization.


Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Leadership

  • Work with the product team in managing end-to-end product lifecycle for Pinkvilla’s web and app platforms
  • Define and drive the product roadmap aligned with business goals (traffic, engagement, revenue)
  • Identify new opportunities in content consumption, personalization, and user experience

User Experience & Growth

  • Improve user journeys across content discovery, reading, video consumption, and sharing
  • Drive SEO, app engagement, retention, and DAU/MAU growth
  • Optimize funnels (homepage → article → video → subscription/ad engagement)

Data & Analytics

  • Use tools like Google Analytics, Firebase, Mixpanel, etc. to track performance
  • Run A/B tests and experiments to improve conversion and engagement
  • Define and monitor key metrics: retention, session time, bounce rate, CTR

Monetization

  • Work closely with revenue teams to optimize ad placements, page performance, and yield
  • Explore new monetization streams (subscriptions, commerce integrations, branded content formats)

Execution & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with engineering, design, editorial, SEO, and sales teams
  • Translate business requirements into clear product requirements (PRDs)
  • Drive sprint planning, prioritization, and timely delivery

Platform & Performance

  • Improve site speed, app performance, and scalability
  • Ensure best practices in Core Web Vitals, app stability, and UX standards


Requirements

Experience

  • 5 - 8+ years in Product Management (preferably in media, content, or consumer internet)
  • Proven experience managing high-traffic websites and mobile apps

Skills

  • Strong understanding of consumer behavior, content platforms, and engagement loops
  • Hands-on with analytics tools (GA4, Firebase, Mixpanel, etc.)
  • Experience working with SEO, content products, or ad-driven businesses
  • Ability to balance editorial needs + product scalability
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

Technical Understanding

  • Good understanding of frontend/backend systems, APIs, CMS platforms
  • Familiarity with app ecosystems (iOS/Android), push notifications, and personalization engines

title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to lead product strategy, execution, and innovation across both our core business and emerging ventures. This is a high-impact leadership role working closely with HOD, founders and business leaders to identify market opportunities, validate new ideas, and build scalable products from 0→1 while continuing to strengthen and scale our existing product ecosystem. The ideal candidate has built and scaled products in product-led organizations and brings experience across B2B, B2C, or B2B2C platforms


What You'll Own

  • Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap across multiple product lines.
  • Lead the development of new products and businesses from concept to scale.
  • Identify and validate new opportunities through customer discovery, market analysis, experimentation, and rapid execution.
  • Build products that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business growth.
  • Drive product decisions using customer insights, data, and commercial impact.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Operations, Growth, Finance, and Leadership teams.
  • Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of Product Managers.
  • Establish strong product management practices, operating rhythms, and execution frameworks.


Key Areas of Ownership

  • New Initiatives & 0→1 Product Development
  • Internal Operations & Workforce Productivity Platforms
  • Asset, Inventory & Infrastructure Management
  • Growth, Customer Experience & Marketplace Products
  • Compliance, Finance & Business Intelligence Platforms


What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of product management experience in high-growth technology companies.
  • Proven experience building and scaling products from 0→1 and 1→N.
  • Experience leading and mentoring Product Managers.
  • Strong product intuition combined with analytical and commercial thinking.
  • Demonstrated success driving cross-functional execution in complex environments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills.


Preferred Experience


  • Product-led B2B, B2C, or B2B2C companies.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Pearl is AI for professional services at global scale, combining advanced AI with verified human expertise to deliver help that is accurate, accountable, and fast. Since 2003, our network has connected millions of customers with licensed professionals across 196 countries, making real expertise available anytime, anywhere.

Our Values

  • Data driven: Data decides, not egos
  • Courageous: We take risks and challenge the status quo
  • Innovative: We're constantly learning, creating, and adapting
  • Lean: We focus on customers, using lean testing to learn how to serve them best
  • Humble: Past success is not a guarantee of future success

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Customer Acquisition, you'll craft customer-focused products that fuel growth. You'll identify new segments, shape product strategies, and own the roadmap for our brand portfolio, including marketing tools, landing pages, and checkout experiences. This cross-functional role involves close collaboration with teams to meet ambitious goals. Using lean methodologies, A/B testing, and agile practices, you'll lead the ideation, development, and launch of impactful features that enhance the customer journey on desktop and mobile.

What You’ll Do

  • You'll be the go-to person for identifying and solving pain points across our marketing teams and customer journey, and you won't just guess, you'll test it all through A/B experiments like a pro.
  • Lead the charge with UX, Analytics, and Engineering to turn sprint planning into sprint winning.
  • Align teams, cut through the noise, and keep everyone rowing in the same direction (yes, you’re that person).
  • Partner closely with Marketing to ensure product and marketing strategies are best friends, not distant cousins.
  • Simplify acquisition workflows, build smart tools, and make “efficiency” more than just a buzzword.
  • Dive deep into the data, spot the growth levers, and bring insights that actually move the needle.
  • Ideate, pitch, and power growth strategies with real business impact.
  • AI-Generated Content: Use generative AI tools to test ad copy, page messaging, and creative assets.
  • AI Collaboration: Work closely with engineering on AI/ML-powered features and translate insights into product decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Overall professional experience of 5+ years is required
  • 4+ years of experience in product management across B2B and B2C products.
  • Possesses hands-on expertise in experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing and multivariate analysis, to drive data-informed decision-making.
  • Experience syncing up with both Paid and Organic Marketing teams — you know how to speak their language.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to identify inefficiencies and proactively implement automation-driven solutions to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Brings a collaborative mindset with a deep appreciation for partnering with UX and Analytics teams to solve meaningful customer problems.
  • Exhibits inspiring leadership, effectively aligning and motivating cross-functional teams toward ambitious, high-impact goals.
  • Leverage generative AI tools to test and optimize ad copy, page messaging, and creative assets, while collaborating closely with engineering teams on AI/ML-powered features to translate insights into effective product decisions.

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace

We welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where professional services are readily available to all. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit, come work with us. Pearl is committed to an inclusive workplace. Pearl is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

AI Disclosure & Informed Consent

Artificial intelligence (AI) technology may be used during the hiring process to record, transcribe, analyze, and rank interview responses. By submitting your application and participating in the interview process, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in the hiring process. For more information see our AI Disclosure and Consent Policy.

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE:

Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai.


ABOUT THE ROLE: Principal Product Manager

As a Principal Product Manager at Aviatrix, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert and thought leader, owning the strategy and long-term vision for a set of interrelated features and solution areas within our multi-cloud networking platform. You will drive significant initiatives that shape product value and market differentiation, influencing the product roadmap at the leadership level.

Working closely with engineering, marketing, sales, and customers, you will identify emerging opportunities, make high-stakes prioritization decisions, and lead cross-functional collaboration that defines Aviatrix's competitive position across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and beyond.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and drive the long-term vision and comprehensive strategy for a set of interrelated features and solution areas, aligning them to the product's strategic goals, market position, and overall company vision.
  • Influence the product roadmap at the leadership level by identifying future opportunities based on emerging industry trends, evolving user needs, and the competitive landscape.
  • Engage regularly with enterprise customers, many of whom are based in the U.S., participating in product discussions, roadmap reviews, and strategic sessions; flexibility to schedule and attend meetings across time zones is expected.
  • Establish prioritization frameworks for interdependent features that are adopted across product teams, and communicate rationale clearly to executive stakeholders.
  • Make critical, high-stakes decisions on feature scope and strategic direction, balancing cross-functional input, market insights, and risk assessment to drive outcomes that impact the broader Product Management function.
  • Lead execution across multiple interrelated features, overseeing project roadmaps, assigning responsibilities across teams, and establishing standards for quality delivery.
  • Anticipate execution risks and adapt plans proactively based on resource or market changes, ensuring smooth cross-functional collaboration.
  • Maintain deep customer focus by synthesizing feedback and real-world enterprise challenges into strategic product decisions, ensuring Aviatrix solutions address critical pain points at scale.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to keep Aviatrix at the forefront of enterprise cloud networking and security.
  • Drive strategic-level communication across functions, providing detailed roadmap updates, vision presentations, and reports to leadership and executive teams.
  • Partner with ecosystem partners and internal teams to validate strategy and deliver measurable, impactful results.
  • Evangelize Aviatrix's solutions as an internal and external subject matter expert through thought leadership, technical white papers, webinars, and speaking engagements.
  • Mentor and develop junior product managers on execution, collaboration, and strategic thinking best practices.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in product management within the cloud or networking domain, with a demonstrated track record of driving product strategy at scale (or 8+ years with a Master's degree).
  • Broad expertise and deep specialization in cloud networking technologies, including VPN, SDN, SD-WAN, firewalls, routing protocols, TCP/IP, DNS, IPSec, and cloud-native networking across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
  • Proven experience leading strategy and execution for a set of interrelated features or product areas, with direct influence on long-term product roadmap and business outcomes.
  • Experience with multi-cloud architectures, networking protocols, and infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Hands-on experience with at least two major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Networking, Azure Networking, Google Cloud Networking).
  • Recognized ability to lead cross-functional collaboration, build consensus, and influence stakeholders up to the executive level.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into strategic narratives for diverse audiences, including C-suite.
  • Experience mentoring and developing junior product managers.
  • Willingness and ability to work flexible hours to accommodate meetings with customers and stakeholders based in the U.S. and other global time zones.

title: Senior Product Manager, Search Platforms
descriptionHtml:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, 0 to 1, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with the use of AI for automation.
  • Experience in navigating product and technology trade-offs.
  • Experience leading products while understanding the end user habits.
  • Experience in a fast-paced environment with nuances of managing high traffic, serving binaries, and making product fundamentals.
  • Experience working with technical product leaders and senior engineers, with the ability to influence resourcing, tech, and product decisions.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In this role, the team is responsible for ensuring that Search delivers on its goals of latency, capacity, and reliability.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Define ideas and execute key goals for search serving binaries and ML infrastructure in collaboration with engineering leadership.
  • Meet the high-compute demands of next-generation AI features.
  • Drive full automation of search binary operations using AI to minimize manual toil.
  • Anticipate future infrastructure needs and manage cross-functional partnerships to build a resilient, future-proof search stack.
  • Build knowledge to bridge the gap between user-centric feature teams and infrastructure reliability.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
01

Why this exists

What if the app that handles your home's money actually understood how homes work?

The Indian consumer payments stack is functionally solved. UPI works. Wallets work. What's not solved is how money actually moves between the people who live together — flatmates settling rent and groceries, partners managing a shared household, families coordinating around staff and bills and birthday gifts. The everyday money inside an Indian home is still a WhatsApp message and a mental note.

Fave is the bet that this changes — and that the company that wins shared money becomes the operating layer for a generation of Indian consumers.

We've built the beta. Real users, real spend, real signal. Now we need someone to own the product as it scales.

02

The role

You'd own the product end-to-end. Strategy, roadmap, ship cadence, the whole thing.

There's no PM org to inherit — you'll build it. There's no playbook for what we're doing — you'll write it. You'll partner with strong, opinionated peers leading engineering and marketing/design who already know the product cold. The job is to bring product judgment to a team that has nearly everything else.

This is not a managerial role with an IC ladder underneath it. You'll lead, but you'll also build. You'll write specs you actually want to write. You'll prototype a feature before scoping it out. You'll ship a thing on a weekend because you couldn't stop thinking about it. The day you stop contributing individually is the day this role stops working.

What you'll spend time on:

→ Cross-functional leadership. Drive alignment with engineering, design, marketing, and BD — without managing them. The hardest part of this job is moving a team you don't own toward a north star they help define.

→ Knowing the customer better than anyone in the room. Live in the segment. Talk to users constantly. Understand the social, financial, and behavioural texture of how young Indians live and spend together. Customer obsession isn't a value here, it's a daily practice.

→ Combining insight and analytics to make agile decisions. You move between qualitative signal and quantitative truth fluently. You don't wait for the perfect dashboard, and you don't shoot from the hip. You triangulate.

→ Running the experimentation engine. Define hypotheses, design tests, decide what's instrumented, call results honestly. The team should ship 5–10 experiments a month, and you should be able to defend every one of them.

→ Owning activation and retention. The cohort retention number is the north star. You live with it, and you're accountable for it.

→ Defining what we build — and what we don't. The hardest call in a product like this isn't "what's possible." It's "what's next." That's yours.

→ Building the product team. First hires within 90 days. Roughly five PMs in 12 months. You'll set the bar.

→ Carrying the product story. Internally to leadership, externally to partners, candidates, and the press. The story matters as much as the product.

03

Who we're looking for

The best product leaders we've worked with don't reach for a 2x2 when the road forks. They look at the product, the users, the team — and they have a view. They hold it well. They change it when the evidence shifts. They don't perform conviction. They have it.

They've also never stopped doing the work. They write the spec, they sit in the user interview, they sketch the flow, they argue the metric definition. The title says "lead" but the day-to-day says "builder."

Must-have

→ Built consumer products people use repeatedly. Mobile-first, high-frequency, habit-forming products are ideal.

→ Strong product judgment across insight, UX, metrics, and prioritisation. You can move from user conversations to flows to cohort reads to roadmap calls without outsourcing the hard thinking.

→ Early-stage product instincts. You know the difference between optimising a working funnel and finding the wedge before the funnel exists.

→ Hands-on builder energy. You can write a sharp spec, sketch a flow, run a user interview, define an experiment, and make the call when signal is messy.

→ Ability to build the product function. You've hired, mentored, or raised the bar for PMs before — even if the team was small.

→ Built inside a startup. You've operated in a small, fast-paced team where speed, ambiguity, and direct ownership were the defaults. You don't need structure to do your best work — you create it.

Strong signals

→ You've built a product where growth came from the product loop itself, not just paid marketing.

→ You understand Indian consumer behaviour — especially how young people, couples, flatmates, and families coordinate money.

→ You've worked on social, fintech, commerce, payments, or other coordination-heavy products.

→ You've operated in a regulated or high-trust environment.

→ You use AI tools every day to increase the leverage of a small team.

→ You have unusually strong taste in product, copy, interaction design, and consumer storytelling.

Not required

→ A fintech background.

→ A big-company product title.

→ Experience managing a large PM org.

Must-have
→ Built consumer products people use repeatedly. Mobile-first, high-frequency, habit-forming products are ideal.
→ Strong product judgment across insight, UX, metrics, and prioritisation. You can move from user conversations to flows to cohort reads to roadmap calls without outsourcing the hard thinking.
→ Early-stage product instincts. You know the difference between optimising a working funnel and finding the wedge before the funnel exists.
→ Hands-on builder energy. You can write a sharp spec, sketch a flow, run a user interview, define an experiment, and make the call when signal is messy.
→ Ability to build the product function. You've hired, mentored, or raised the bar for PMs before — even if the team was small.
→ Built inside a startup. You've operated in a small, fast-paced team where speed, ambiguity, and direct ownership were the defaults. You don't need structure to do your best work — you create it.
Strong signals
→ You've built a product where growth came from the product loop itself, not just paid marketing.
→ You understand Indian consumer behaviour — especially how young people, couples, flatmates, and families coordinate money.
→ You've worked on social, fintech, commerce, payments, or other coordination-heavy products.
→ You've operated in a regulated or high-trust environment.
→ You use AI tools every day to increase the leverage of a small team.
→ You have unusually strong taste in product, copy, interaction design, and consumer storytelling.
Not required
→ A fintech background.
→ A big-company product title.
→ Experience managing a large PM org.

title: Lead Product – Alternates
descriptionHtml:
Lead Product – Alternates


Role Overview

Lead the alternate products platform by driving product strategy, fund selection, due diligence, and distribution support across Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit, Real Estate, and Infrastructure investments. The role involves building a differentiated product shelf, evaluating investment opportunities, supporting wealth teams, and driving product adoption among UHNI and Family Office clients


Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Fund Selection

  • Build and manage the alternate products platform across PE/VC, Private Credit, Real Estate, and Infrastructure
  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard high-quality domestic and global fund managers
  • Develop and maintain a strong product pipeline aligned with client needs and market trends
  • Review and enhance product onboarding policies, due diligence standards, and eligibility criteria

Investment Due Diligence & Monitoring

  • Lead end-to-end due diligence covering investment strategy, fund structure, legal documentation, manager track record, operations, and risk assessmen
  • t.Prepare investment committee notes with recommendations and key risk consideration
  • s.Monitor onboarded products through performance reviews, manager interactions, capital calls, distributions, and compliance tracking
  • Identify and escalate potential risks, portfolio stress indicators, and performance concerns

Co-Investments & Portfolio Solutions

  • Evaluate and structure co-investment opportunities for UHNI and Family Office clients
  • Support portfolio construction and product suitability assessments

Distribution & Sales Enablement

  • Create product presentations, investment notes, comparison reports, and client communication materials
  • Conduct training sessions for Relationship Managers and Wealth Advisors
  • Partner with sales teams and participate in client meetings for alternate investment discussions
  • Work closely with stakeholders to drive product penetration and sales growth

Experience & Qualification

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in financial services
  • At least 8 years of experience in alternate investments, private markets, product management, fund selection, investment advisory, or related areas
  • Strong understanding of Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure, AIFs, PMS, and alternative investment products
  • Experience in investment due diligence, manager evaluation, portfolio monitoring, and client-facing product discussions

title: Senior Product Manager I
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager I - Agent Platform & Governance

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager I to help define how AI agents, MCP clients, and enterprise workflows safely interact with the Sumo Logic platform.

As AI becomes a broader interface for accessing data, insights, and platform capabilities, customers need confidence that every agentic workflow is secure, governed, auditable, and aligned with enterprise controls. This role will own key product areas across MCP strategy, agent governance, headless invocation, agent-to-agent integrations, RBAC, rate limiting, throttling, quotas, admin controls, and auditability.

You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security, AI, platform, and customer-facing teams to turn ambiguous platform and governance needs into scalable product capabilities. This is a hands-on role for someone who can operate at the intersection of technical platform depth, enterprise customer trust, and fast-moving AI product strategy.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own product strategy and execution for MCP and governed agent access to Sumo Logic capabilities.
  • Define how agents, tools, skills, APIs, and external clients can safely interact with the Sumo Logic platform.
  • Drive requirements for headless agent invocation, including access patterns across external clients, partner tools, IDEs, terminals, Slack, and other future surfaces.
  • Shape Sumo Logic’s approach to agent-to-agent integrations, including invocation boundaries, trust models, permissioning, and auditability.
  • Define governance models for tools, skills, agents, context, memory, and reusable content across the AI platform.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture on rate limiting, throttling, quotas, tenant isolation, abuse prevention, and safe defaults for agentic workflows.
  • Drive product requirements for RBAC, data access controls, service accounts, OAuth/API access, service allowlisting, and admin-configured policies as they apply to agents and MCP-based access.
  • Define enterprise admin controls for managing agent access, approved tools, accessible content, long-term memory, context sources, and policy enforcement.
  • Ensure agentic actions are observable, auditable, permission-aware, and explainable to enterprise admins.
  • Translate strategic direction into crisp PRDs, proposals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollout plans.
  • Use telemetry to monitor agent usage, MCP adoption, tool calls, rate-limit hits, permission failures, policy violations, latency, and operational reliability.
  • Create leadership-facing proposals that clearly explain tradeoffs across customer demand, governance, platform complexity, and long-term architecture.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms, security, IAM, APIs, AI platforms, developer platforms, observability, or security products.
  • Strong technical product instincts around permissions, governance, APIs, platform architecture, admin controls, and enterprise-scale systems.
  • Familiarity with AI agent concepts such as MCP, tools, skills, agent orchestration, headless invocation, agent-to-agent workflows, context, memory, and guardrails.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise controls such as RBAC, OAuth, API keys, service accounts, audit logs, policy enforcement, rate limits, throttling, quotas, and data access boundaries.
  • Ability to ask the right questions, identify edge cases, and think through how product capabilities behave under real enterprise constraints.
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, failures, and risk.
  • Strong communication skills across both technical and business audiences.
  • Ability to write clear product proposals, decision docs, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • A fast learner who can quickly ramp on emerging areas like MCP, agent governance, AI platform architecture, and enterprise AI controls.
  • High ownership, hustle, and drive to make progress in ambiguous, fast-moving product areas.

Must-Have Qualities

  • Asks the right questions - especially around trust, permissioning, edge cases, customer impact, and failure modes.
  • Strong communicator - can explain complex platform and governance concepts clearly.
  • High drive and ownership - pushes through ambiguity and drives execution.
  • Strong analytical capability — uses data to prioritize, validate, and refine product decisions.
  • Quick learner - can rapidly understand MCP, governance, IAM, AI agents, and platform architecture.
  • Tradeoff thinker - can frame options, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly.

Why Join Sumo Logic?

You will be working on one of the largest scale data problems in the industry. Your work directly impacts the company’s bottom line and determines our ability to innovate by freeing up capital for new product investments.

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

title: Senior Product Manager 1
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

The Opportunity:

Are you an aspiring product leader with a passion for building innovative products? Nielsen is seeking enthusiastic and strategic Product Managers to join our growing product team. In this role, you will help define, develop, and launch products that address user needs and drive business impact. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams from ideation through execution, ensuring our products meet market demands and exceed customer expectations, with a strong emphasis on solid product fundamentals and data-driven decision making.

What You'll Do

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Contribute to developing and articulating the product vision and strategy for your assigned product area, ensuring alignment with company goals. Support identifying market opportunities, customer needs, and competitive landscapes to inform product direction.
  • Roadmap Contribution: Assist in building and maintaining the product roadmap by helping prioritize features and initiatives based on strategic value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
  • Requirements Definition: Translate user needs, business requirements, and technical capabilities into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success teams throughout the product lifecycle. Facilitate effective communication and coordination to ensure successful product delivery.
  • Market & Customer Research: Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews to gain valuable insights into user behavior, pain points, and emerging trends.
  • Data-Driven Performance & Iteration: Assist in defining and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) for your products. Monitor product performance and use data-driven insights to identify opportunities for improvement and guide future iterations.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders, proactively communicating product updates, progress, and key learnings.

Qualifications

What You'll Bring:

  • Overall 6-10 years of experience with minimum 4 years in product management required
  • MBA from a top Indian or global business school and technical undergraduate degree strongly preferred
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically and translate ideas into actionable plans and detailed product requirements.
  • Technical Acumen: Foundational understanding of software development processes and technologies, enabling effective collaboration with technical teams.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a demonstrated capacity to use data to inform product decisions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a positive team environment.
  • Customer Focus: Deep empathy for users and a passion for building products that solve real problems.

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Overview

Job Overview

At Microsoft, we are building trusted, developer‑centric AI platforms that enable organizations to build, deploy, and operate AI systems at global scale. Microsoft Foundry is a unified platform for experimentation, training, deployment, monitoring, and governance of AI workloads. As a Principal Product Manager, you will be a senior contributor shaping priorities for critical company‑level AI platform surfaces, working in close partnership with other Principal PMs and engineering leaders. You will contribute to defining long‑term direction for next‑generation AI/ML and GenAI workloads, including custom code training, large‑scale distributed compute, developer‑facing APIs and SDKs, and enterprise‑grade governance and reliability. You will operate at company scale, influencing multiple product and engineering teams and partnering closely with senior

technical and business leaders. This role offers the opportunity to help define durable platform abstractions that unlock innovation for developers, data scientists, and ML engineers, while contributing to Microsoft’s long‑term AI platform direction.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a senior contributor to platform strategy for Azure AI Foundry and Azure ML, helping shape multi-year investments across model training, customization, deployment, and lifecycle management.
  • Drive alignment and progress across federated, cross-organizational initiatives, working with peer Principal PMs and multiple engineering teams on shared platform outcomes.
  • Contribute to the definition and evolution of high-leverage platform abstractions (APIs, SDKs, workflows) that enable scalable adoption of GenAI and custom code training workloads.
  • Partner closely with senior engineering leaders to influence architectural direction, surface trade-offs, and ensure platform capabilities meet scale, reliability, and security expectations.
  • Engage with strategic customers and internal stakeholders to gather insights, validate requirements, and translate learnings into durable, reusable platform capabilities.
  • Use data, metrics, and experimentation to evaluate impact and inform product decisions across shared ownership areas.
  • Serve as a thought leader and mentor, elevating product craft, platform thinking, and responsible AI practices across the organization.

Qualifications

Must-have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • Significant experience (typically 8–12+ years) in product management or software engineering with substantial product ownership, including experience working on platform or infrastructure products.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in large, ambiguous, multi‑team environments with shared ownership and complex dependencies.
  • Strong technical depth in cloud platforms, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure, with the ability to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects.
  • Proven track record of influencing strategy, driving alignment, and delivering outcomes through collaboration rather than direct authority.
  • Strong analytical and systems‑thinking skills, with experience making high‑quality decisions in fast‑moving, evolving problem spaces

Preferred

  • Experience building platforms for developers, data scientists, or ML engineers.
  • Hands‑on exposure to AI/ML or GenAI workloads, including model training, customization, or serving.
  • Experience contributing to platforms operating at global scale, including multi‑region or regulated enterprise environments.
  • Experience with product‑led growth, extensibility, or ecosystem‑oriented platform design.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.


We are looking for a technically sharp and AI-curious Product Manager to join our Non Human Identity Product team. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of product strategy and hands-on innovation — translating complex identity security challenges into elegant, data-driven product experiences. You will be expected to not just define what to build, but actively prototype solutions using modern AI tools, collaborate tightly with engineering, and own outcomes end to end. This is a high-impact role for someone who loves rolling up their sleeves, has a strong engineering foundation, and is genuinely excited about the possibilities of AI-accelerated product development.


WHAT YOU WILL DOYou are the entrepreneur of your product. You own the outcome — not just the backlog. That means setting direction, removing obstacles, making hard calls, and being accountable for whether the product succeeds in the market.
 
Own the Product Outcome
• Drive the roadmap for Non-Human Identity (NHI) Posture and Management — from initial discovery through GA — with clear success metrics tied to business impact.
• Define what winning looks like for each product area: revenue targets, adoption milestones, retention benchmarks, and competitive positioning.
• Make prioritisation decisions with conviction, balancing short-term customer commitments against long-term strategic bets.
• Own the financial success of your product — work closely with GTM, sales, and leadership to understand revenue contribution, pipeline influence, and expansion opportunities driven by product capabilities. 
 
Find and Validate Product-Market Fit 
• Treat every new product as a hypothesis: design lightweight experiments, define clear PMF signals, and iterate rapidly until the market responds.
• Own the 0→1 journey for new Non-Human Identity capabilities — from problem validation through early adopter traction to repeatable growth.
• Identify the right customer segment, articulate a crisp value proposition, and ensure positioning is sharp enough to win in a competitive identity security market.
• Know when to pivot and when to push — use data and direct customer signal to make that call early. 
 
Obsess Over Customer Success
• Treat customer outcomes as the ultimate measure of product quality — not features shipped or deadlines met.
• Engage directly and continuously with customers: be present at onboarding, sit in on support escalations, and run regular discovery conversations to stay close to real-world pain.
• Set a high bar for every launch: ensure customers don’t just adopt the product but actively succeed with it and expand usage over time.
• Champion the voice of the customer internally — bring their reality into every roadmap discussion, sprint review, and executive update. 
 
Build with AI — Technically and at Speed
• Rapidly prototype concepts using AI platforms (Claude, OpenAI, Cursor, etc.) to validate ideas before committing engineering resources.
• Architect and execute proof-of-concept builds that demonstrate new product directions to stakeholders and customers with working software, not slides.
• Stay current with the evolving AI tooling landscape and champion adoption of tools that accelerate the team’s velocity. 
 
Data & Analytics
• Instrument products from day one — define the metrics, own the dashboards, and use data to drive every major prioritisation decision.
• Build a continuous improvement loop: measure feature adoption, identify friction, form a hypothesis, test, and iterate.
• Partner with data engineering to ensure the right telemetry is in place before, not after, launch. 
 
Lead Across the Business
• Align engineering, design, sales, and customer success around a shared definition of success — and hold the team accountable to it.
• Drive sprint planning, dependency management, and cross-functional decision-making with clarity and speed. • Communicate roadmap decisions and product strategy to executive stakeholders in the language of business outcomes. 
 
 
 
 
 
 


WHAT YOU BRING•10 years of product management experience, with at least 4 years in a B2B SaaS environment.
 • Hands-on experience building with AI tools (Claude, OpenAI APIs, Cursor, or similar) — and fluency in structured, spec-driven AI development: you write clear specs, use AI to accelerate implementation, and review and own the output. Not just vibe coding.
• Strong software development background — you’ve written production-quality code in one or more of Go (Golang), Java, Python, or JavaScript, and can reason deeply about system architecture, APIs, and data models.
• Solid grasp of identity and access management concepts (SSO, RBAC, directory services, identity governance, Non-Human Identity) — experience with identity security or Zero Trust architecture is strongly preferred.
• Track record of leading cross-functional teams and delivering complex features on time.
• Exposure to LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, or AI agent workflows.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills — you can simplify the complex.
 
Nice to Have
• Prior experience at an early-to-mid stage startup where you wore multiple hats. • Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns.

- Review (initially and annually thereafter), understand, and adhere to Information Security/Privacy Policies and Procedures such as (but not limited to):

> Incident Response Policy/Procedures

> Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Policy/Procedures

> Mobile Device Policy

> Account Management Policy

> Access Control Policy

> Personnel Security Policy

> Privacy Policy

title: Senior Product Manager - CloudSEK Platforms
descriptionHtml:
WHO ARE WE?


We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:


  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Why this role exists


CloudSEK helps enterprises predict and prioritize threats before breach, not just react after one. Our stack spans digital risk protection (XVigil), attack surface management (BeVigil), supply chain intelligence (SVigil), and threat intelligence, unified on Nexus AI: an AI command center that correlates signals, maps attack paths, and quantifies risk in terms security and business leaders understand.


We’re at an inflection point: strong products in each domain, growing international footprint, and a platform bet to connect the dots for customers. We need a Senior PM who thinks in cybersecurity outcomes - exposure, threat context, prioritization, remediation - and can turn that into products customers adopt and expand on.


What you’ll own


You’ll own significant product areas on the CloudSEK Platform, shaping how enterprise security teams discover risk, understand threat context, and act with confidence.

Your work will sit at the intersection of:


  • Threat intelligence & early warning reconnaissance-stage signals - CVE/IAV context, actor and campaign awareness
  • External risk visibility - digital risk, brand abuse, leaked credentials, and attack surface exposure
  • Prioritization & action - helping customers answer what matters most, why, and what to do next (not another feed of alerts)
  • Platform experience - workflows, integrations, and cross-product capabilities that make CloudSEK feel like one intelligence system, not four separate tools


You’ll partner closely with Threat Intel Research, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Customer Success . Our research capability is a core differentiator, and this role helps translate it into product buyers can operationalize.


What you’ll do


Product strategy

  • Research market trends, competitive moves, and customer workflows across DRP, ASM, TI, and platform consolidation
  • Define and communicate product vision and roadmap aligned with CloudSEK’s growth
  • Prioritize investments that drive adoption, retention, and expansion in existing accounts


Product development

  • Partner with engineering to turn customer and research insights into clear requirements, releases, and measurable outcomes
  • Work with design so complex security data is usable for analysts, threat hunters, and executive stakeholders
  • Balance speed and quality on a roadmap that spans point capabilities and platform-level experiences


Go-to-market

  • Shape positioning, messaging, and sales enablement for new capabilities
  • Help Marketing and Sales articulate CloudSEK’s differentiation vs. point solutions and legacy intel vendors


Customer engagement

  • Engage directly with enterprise customers to validate decisions, improve adoption, and uncover expansion opportunities
  • Close the loop on product friction with CS and account teams


Metrics

  • Define and track KPIs for platform health, feature adoption, and customer outcomes
  • Use quantitative and qualitative signals to refine priorities continuously


Who we’re looking for


Must-have

  • 7–10 years in product management, with substantial experience in B2B cybersecurity
  • Deep familiarity with how security teams work and how cyber products are evaluated, bought, and used in enterprise environments
  • Hands-on product experience in at least one of: threat intelligence, attack surface / exposure management, digital risk protection, vulnerability prioritization, security operations workflows, or security platform / data products
  • Supply chain, third-party, or vendor risk - meaningful experience here is important; you understand TPRM / software supply chain problems and how they connect to broader security posture
  • Strong analytical judgment and clear communication across technical researchers, engineers, and business buyers
  • Comfort in agile, high-velocity product environments


Strong plus

  • Experience building SaaS platform capabilities unified workflows, integrations, APIs, RBAC, or cross-product experiences that connect multiple security domains
  • Exposure to risk quantification, attack-path / graph thinking, or AI-assisted prioritization
  • Experience with global enterprise buyers and security procurement
  • Bachelor’s or MBA; technical degree is a plus but not required if domain depth is clear


Why join CloudSEK


  • Cybersecurity - AI native company - prediction and IAV-focused narrative, not a bolt-on security module on generic SaaS
  • Full-stack exposure story DRP, ASM, TI, and supply chain in one portfolio; platform correlation is the strategic bet
  • Research ↔ product - work adjacent to a serious threat research org, not distant from it
  • Global momentum - product choices here shape how we win and retain enterprise accounts internationally

The Company

Comviva is an industry leader for providing digital platforms crafted for telecom operators, banks, financial services organizations, and other enterprises. We provide solutions for BSS, banking and fintech, AI-led marketing automation and messaging platforms, which have been recognized by leading research firms, including Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Frost & Sullivan, ISG, Juniper Research, Rocco Research, amongst others.

Noteworthy among our accolades is the second position in Digital Wallet platforms by Juniper Research and a consistent placement in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for IRCM for three consecutive years. The breadth of recognition extends across several Gartner reports, encompassing Partner Relationship Management, CSP Customer Management, Revenue Monetization, Artificial Intelligence for CSPs, CPaaS, and Digital Commerce.

Forrester has acknowledged Comviva's prowess in Real Time Interaction Management, Cross-Channel Marketing, Loyalty and Rewards, Enterprise Marketing, Customer Analytics, Journey Orchestration, Digital Banking, and Marketplace Development. In the Digital Commerce domain, IDC's flagship Marketscape report has recognized our contributions.

ISG mentions Comviva for our Mobiquity Banking Suite in their ISG Provider Lens report, and Omdia includes us in their Omdia Universe for Digital Banking platforms. Juniper Research and Rocco Research consistently feature Comviva in their competitor leaderboard for key reports covering CPaaS, A2P Messaging, SMS Firewall, mobile money, CDP, and more.

Our commitment to excellence extends beyond technology, as evidenced by multiple awards, including the 'Great Place to Work For' Certification (2019), Top 25 Best Workplaces for Women (2019), Golden Peacock Awards (2023), Times Ascent 'Dream Companies to work for 2023, Brandon Hall HCM Excellence Gold Award (2022), and ASSOCHAM Diversity & Inclusion Excellence Award (2021) in the HR Excellence category.

Comviva's technological innovations have earned international and regional acclaim, with recognition at prestigious awards such as GSMA GLOMO (3 Times Winner), Global Telecoms (GLOTEL) Awards, Frost & Sullivan's "Digital Marketing Company of the Year," AITE Group Digital Wallet Innovation Awards, AfricaCom Awards, World Communication Awards, Juniper Research Future Digital Awards, Asia Communication Awards, Global Telecoms Business Innovation Awards, Golden Peacock Awards for Innovation, Banking Technology Awards, Global Carrier Award, IBS Intelligence Global FinTech Innovation Awards, Global Fintech Awards, Asia Fintech Awards, Emerging Payments Awards, PayTech Awards, and Telecoms World Middle-East Awards.

These accolades stand as a testament to our unwavering commitment to assisting clients in their digital transformation journey, offering cutting-edge technology that empowers end-users with new-age products and services.

Comviva is looking for strong Retail/CPG domain experts to partner closely with our product team and drive D2C expansion initiatives.

  • Experience with omnichannel journeys, personalization, and consumer lifecycle management

  • Focus: Work alongside product teams to shape CPG D2C use cases, strategy, and platform evolution

📧 zuhi.karn@comviva.com

📱 9999890363 (WhatsApp only)
