title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Overview

Lead the vision and execution for next-generation agentic AI products—designing generative experiences across search, chat and other agentic experiences. As a Principal Product Manager (PM) for the Search & AI team, you’ll architect solutions that reason, plan, and act across applications, the web, and the OS, empowering users to accomplish complex tasks with intelligence and reliability.

You’ll join a high-impact team that uses the cutting edge of generative model and applies to high-value product experiences across Search and Copilot. Search & AI Experiences team thrives on rapid innovation, cross-functional collaboration, and a culture that values curiosity, autonomy, and bold problem-solving. We work across a range of experiences spanning from user intent understanding, semantic understanding of queries and documents, vector-based information retrieval, generating card answers and user experiences and generative query suggestions. We also work on leading edge of Responsible AI techniques to ensure high quality user interactions. We seek PMs who have shipped 0-to-1 agentic products at leading AI startups or labs, great product sense and user experience instincts, driven growth or mindshare in the AI space, and excel in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

If you’re energized by building the future of generative AI experiences and want to shape how intelligent agents empower millions, we want to hear from you!

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50-mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

As a Principal Product Manager, you will:

  • Define and deliver on the strategicroadmap and vision across multiple initiatives.
  • Identify user workflows where AI adds clear value, basing decisions on data and user feedback.
  • Turn model capabilities into specific product features, define MVPs, and refine them using user and business metrics.
  • Work directly with applied science, engineering, and design to turn AI research into practical products that scale and serve users well.
  • Create and use evaluation methods to track product quality, user experience, and safety throughout development.
  • Write clear documents to keep stakeholders aligned on product goals, priorities, and decisions.
  • Promote adoption by representing Microsoft AI at industry events, showing how technical features translate into user benefits and growth.
  • Make informed decisions in uncertain situations, manage risks and incidents, and support continuous improvement through postmortem review.
  • Be the thought-leader for driving DAU growth across teams.
  • Prioritize features to maximize DAU growth – build and partner with feature teams.
  • Envision and implement distribution tactics for the product growth– these include cross org execution of entry points, external partnerships for mobile & desktop DAU and other growth hacks.
  • Create win-win partnership pitches and evolve strategic partnerships to drive growth across industry and research labs.
  • Manage, implement and deliver cross-org growth initiatives through collaboration & evangelism.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
    • OR equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience launching 0-to-1 products (from concept to market) in a consumer-facing product environment.
  • 3+ years of experience building products that leverage AI/ML technologies.
  • Experience managing and shipping products in an AI lab or an AI-focused startup.
  • Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, research) to deliver user-facing features.
  • Familiarity with experimentation tools, data analytics, and strong in vibe coding / working knowledge of coding (Python, JavaScript, SQL).
  • Excellent analytical, communication, presentation and negotiation skills with cross-functional organizations, customers and stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, possesses a high energy level to react to situations quickly and decisively, possessing self-confidence to be assertive when taking a position, not afraid to make decisions.
  • Passionate & capable of driving cross-functional initiatives – product features, distribution tactics & partnerships.
  • Demonstrated expertise in growing consumer products of large scale globally.

#MicrosoftAI

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

- Familiarity with experimentation tools, data analytics, and strong in vibe coding / working knowledge of coding (Python, JavaScript, SQL).
- Excellent analytical, communication, presentation and negotiation skills with cross-functional organizations, customers and stakeholders.
- Entrepreneurial mindset, possesses a high energy level to react to situations quickly and decisively, possessing self-confidence to be assertive when taking a position, not afraid to make decisions.
- Passionate & capable of driving cross-functional initiatives – product features, distribution tactics & partnerships. 
- Demonstrated expertise in growing consumer products of large scale globally.

title: Senior Product Manager - Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Product Manager – Supply Chain Management, you will own and evolve the technology platforms and workflows that power Licious’ end-to-end supply chain. You will work closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Data, Engineering, and Finance teams to build products that improve freshness, reduce waste, and enable scalable growth.

This role requires strong product judgment, comfort with operational complexity, and the ability to balance speed, reliability, and long-term platform thinking.



What makes the role meaty...


Product Strategy & Ownership

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for supply chain systems across demand planning, procurement, production planning, warehousing, inventory, and logistics
  • Translate business goals (freshness, fill rate, cost, SLA adherence) into clear product outcomes and success metrics
  • Identify automation and digitization opportunities across supply chain workflows

Execution & Delivery

  • Lead discovery, prioritization, and delivery of features across internal platforms
  • Write high-quality PRDs, define user journeys, and ensure on-time execution with engineering and design teams
  • Drive experimentation and continuous improvement using data and operational feedback

Demand, Inventory & Planning

  • Build products that improve forecast accuracy, replenishment, and inventory turns
  • Partner with Data Science teams on forecasting models and decision-support tools
  • Enable real-time visibility into inventory, wastage, and capacity across nodes

Operations & Reliability

  • Design systems that ensure traceability, compliance, and quality control
  • Improve exception management, alerts, and operational dashboards
  • Balance system reliability with rapid iteration in a 24x7 operational environment

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the product SPOC for Supply Chain and Operations leadership
  • Collaborate with Finance, Category, and Retail teams on cost, margins, and availability
  • Influence roadmap trade-offs by balancing operational needs and tech scalability


We hope that you have..


Experience

  • 6–10 years of product management experience, preferably in Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, Retail Ops, or Food/FMCG
  • Hands-on experience building internal platforms or operational products
  • Proven track record of shipping complex products in high-scale environments

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong problem-solving and structured thinking
  • Data-driven mindset; comfort working with metrics, dashboards, and models
  • Ability to work with ambiguity and evolving operational constraints
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and influence skills

Good to Have

  • Experience in fresh food, cold chain, or perishable supply chains
  • Exposure to demand forecasting, inventory optimization, or WMS/TMS systems
  • Experience working with data science and optimization problems

title: Principal Product Manager, API Platform
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

 

Job summary

We are seeking Principal Platform Product Manager to define and lead DigiCert's API platform as both an internal engineering standard and externally differentiated developer product. This is a dual access role: inbound, you are the Platform authority who sets API structure, governance, guardrails and developer experience standards that all DigiCert product teams build to. Outbound, you are the thought leader who shapes the developer portal, external API experience and MCP strategy that customers, partners and 3rd party developers depend on. The person in this role will simultaneously be the most demanding internal API standard setter and the most credible external advocate for what a best-in-class digital trust API platform can be.

The Principal Platform Product Manager is responsible to understand market needs and trends, collaborate with product teams horizontally across the portfolio, manage the delivery and success of initiatives and supporting platform components in a data-driven manner, and drive priorities that maximize platform value to both internal and external customers. The Principal Platform Product Manager will lead strategic and tactical activities for large, broad, and highly complex initiatives that impact all portfolio solutions, not limited to Platform. This is a critical, highly visible role charged with the strategy and driving the execution of priority initiatives at all levels across the organization. Individuals in this role will also mentor lower-level contributors. This role has a seat on the Platform Product Management team. 

 

What you will do

The Principal API Platform Product Manager serves as the primary owner of our API Platform initiative, with substantial contribution and stakes in several other Platform initiatives. In support of this mission, this role will conduct internal and external research: customer requirements, market requirements, competitive research, internal research and analysis to inform strategic direction and priorities. They will establish a backlog of portfolio requirements that express dependencies on the Platform and actively maintain a prioritized stack-ranking to inform their executable roadmap and regularly collaborate across the business to collect and socialize a comprehensive, accurate and detailed set of feature requirements for one or more major platform initiatives. As the thought leader for API Platform, this role is responsible for constructing both the internal and external visions and leading discussions with functional leadership across the organization to gain alignment.   Primary responsibilities and Duties include:   Outbound Elements:
  • Own the collective API vision for Platform, including strategy, planning, and execution - and share accountability for the outcome
  • Serve as externally facing subject matter expert with customer, partner and developer audiences to gain deep understanding of their needs, represent strategy and roadmap, solicit participation in proof of concepts, beta releases, advisory counsels
  • Serve as thought leader for API requirements at DigiCert: meet with analysts to discuss market dynamics and competitive positioning, publish articles/white papers, post relevant content to engage with their external stakeholder community
  • Work closely with Finance to develop Pricing and Packaging strategies
  • Work closely with Marketing to develop GTM strategy, messaging, positioning and supporting artifacts

Inbound Elements: 

  • Own and understand API-specific platform requirements such as developer experience, webhook frameworks, API governance, security/compliance controls, automated documentation, version/change management; serve as subject matter expert for API requirements across functions to drive collaboration and achieve alignment on objectives, requirements, dependencies, design, and implementation
  • Leads the decomposition of strategic objectives into phased operational and tactical goals and measures that translates into platform implications (e.g. APIs, metering, lifecycle management, reporting, portal), and work with the teams in each of these areas establish requirements, align on priorities, and choreograph delivery
  • Lead the discussion to set business priorities that feed into the planning and execution of API Platform in close collaboration with other product teams and functions to ensure alignment with the needs of the business.
  • Responsible and accountable for the technical vision, strategy, planning and execution - and shares accountability for the outcome
  • Work across all platform teams (e.g. Access Control, API, Common Services, Customer Experience) on roadmap planning cycles, backlog discovery and prioritization, pre-development design and alignment, and operational execution
  • Be responsible and accountable for API Platform acceptance and success criteria of every internal and external release
  • Leads the buy/build assessment for platform components where appropriate, along with vendor assessment and proposal
  • Owns the technical definition, prioritization and hygiene of product backlog(s) throughout the concept through delivery process
  • Owns the execution and outcome by partnering closely with immediate platform core team (Engineering, Architecture & UX) as well solutions core teams to represent business objectives along with support

Skills/Competencies:

  • Proven aptitude for cross-functional diplomacy leading complex initiatives with portfolio-wide implications and impact across all organizational functions
  • Demonstrated ability to lead the solutioning to deconstruct technical challenges to meet stakeholder requirements and platform objectives
  • Mastery of balanced decision making and decision follow-through – including problem definition, alternative definition and selection, trade-off analysis, success criteria definition, and overall execution
  • Able to earn credibility as the internally recognized specialist on complex platform technical and business matters. Uses judgment within broadly defined policies and practices and solves most problems without assistance 
  • Experience and demonstrated dedication managing and meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers; seeking first-hand customer information and using it to inform feature definition and development; bringing a cohesive perspective of the customers to their work
  • Proficient decision making and decision follow-through - including defining a problem, identifying different alternatives, selecting and implementing the best alternative, and evaluating results to success criteria
  • Highly detail-oriented and able to manage many tasks for multiple requesters simultaneously
  • Ability to foster credibility amongst peers, to find common ground and solve problems for the good of all, represent their own interests yet be fair to other groups, can solve problems with with a minimum of disruption/escalation

 

What you will have

  • 10 + years of experience in a technical or product role
  • Proven experience and depth of understanding of Enterprise API Governance and best practices
  • Experience with / working understanding of commercial API Platforms and the problems they solve for customers, partners and developers
  • A working understanding of Model Context Protocol, and how it is used in association with APIs by internal and external stakeholders
  • Credential or degree in business or engineering/computer science 

 

Nice to have

  • Platform Product Management Experience
  • MBA or Advanced Technical degree/credentials 

 

Benefits

  • Generous time off policies
  • Top shelf benefits
  • Education, wellness and lifestyle support

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Role:


You will work at the intersection of academic complexity and intuitive product design, translating the needs of administrators, faculty, and students into features that genuinely transform how institutions operate. You will collaborate closely with engineering, design, customer success, and sales to deliver a product that resonates with institutions across India and beyond.


Roles & Responsibilities

● Own and evolve the product roadmap for the Academics vertical — covering attendance, timetabling, curriculum, course registration, class creation, LMS, feedback, surveys, and PhD/research modules.

● Prioritise features and enhancements by synthesising customer feedback, usage analytics, and institutional trends in higher education.

● Balance short-term customer requests with long-term platform vision, ensuring decisions align with Digii’s growth objectives.

● Conduct regular discovery sessions with academic administrators, faculty, and students across partner institutions to surface pain points and unmet needs.

● Analyse product usage data, support tickets, and market signals to identify gaps and new product opportunities within the academics vertical.

● Partner with customer success and sales teams to bring the voice of the customer into every sprint and planning cycle.

● Translate complex academic workflows into clear, actionable PRDs and user stories that engineering and design teams can execute on with confidence.

● Drive agile ceremonies — sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives — ensuring the team ships high-quality releases on time.

● Coordinate cross-functional launches with design, engineering, QA, and go-to-market teams to ensure smooth feature rollouts.

● Monitor adoption, engagement, and outcome metrics post-launch and iterate rapidly based on data and user feedback.

● Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, ensuring the most impactful work is always prioritised.

● Act as the primary product contact for academics module stakeholders — internally (sales, CS, engineering) and externally (institutional admins and faculty).

● Communicate product progress, roadmap priorities, and release timelines clearly and regularly to leadership and cross-functional peers.


Requirements Must Haves

● 4–6 years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS or education technology, with a strong track record of shipping B2B SaaS products end-to-end.

● Proven ability to own a product vertical independently — from discovery and roadmap definition to execution and post-launch iteration.

● Strong understanding of academic workflows in higher education — including timetabling, curriculum management, LMS, attendance, and student lifecycle processes.

● Data-driven decision-making: comfortable with product analytics tools and translating metrics into product improvements.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared product vision.

● Hands-on experience working in agile environments, running sprint ceremonies, and managing product backlogs.


Good to Have

● Prior experience working with Indian higher education institutions — universities, deemed universities, or autonomous colleges.

● Familiarity with LMS platforms (Moodle, Canvas, or proprietary platforms) and academic ERP systems.

● Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar.

● Working knowledge of tools like Jira, Confluence, and Figma.

● Experience collaborating with customer-facing teams (sales, support, customer success) to gather and action institutional feedback.

● Passion for the education sector and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for students and institutions.


Digii’s commitment to you

● Opportunity to make a dent in higher education globally.Competitive Pay

● An open culture that thrives on passion and excellence.

● A true sense of satisfaction where your work would help millions of students have a better campus experience.

● Access to top entrepreneurs, technologists, and leaders for brainstorming and mentorship.

● This role is based in Bangalore (on-site). Management trusts you to make the best use of your time, with performance measured by impact, not hours.

● We believe this opportunity will be a success for everyone when we truly unlock your potential. This role has strong room for growth in the organisation.

title: Senior Product Manager - Customer Fulfillment & Post-Order Experience
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the Customer Fulfillment, Delivery Experience and Post-Order charter for one of the business under Nykaa ecosystem.

This is a high-ownership role where you will be responsible for defining and scaling the end-to-end customer journey after purchase- from delivery promises and order orchestration to tracking, returns, exchanges, customer support, and fulfillment operations.

You will work closely with Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, and Data Science teams to build a world-class commerce experience from the ground up.

What You'll Own

Commerce & Marketplace Platforms

Own the foundational commerce platforms that power the business, including catalog management, seller and vendor experience, marketplace operations, order management systems, fulfillment workflows, logistics integrations, and operational tooling.

End-to-End Customer & Fulfillment Experience

Own the customer journey from order placement through fulfillment and post-order experiences. You will be responsible for building scalable capabilities across delivery promise (EDD), speed propositions, order tracking, cancellations, returns, exchanges, refunds, customer communications, self-service journeys, and customer support enablement.

Product Strategy & Execution

Act as the product owner for a key business vertical, driving product strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, PRD creation, execution, and launch.


What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience.
  • Experience building and scaling customer-facing products in e-commerce, marketplaces, logistics, quick-commerce, retail-tech, or supply-chain domains.

Preferred Background

Experience in at least four or more:

  • Catalog & Seller management
  • Fulfillment and logistics platforms
  • Order Management Systems (OMS)
  • Marketplace products
  • Delivery promise (EDD) systems
  • Customer service platforms
  • Returns and reverse logistics
  • Quick commerce or hyperlocal fulfillment
  • Omnichannel commerce

Skills

  • Strong product thinking and execution skills.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and build products from first principles.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Experience working across multiple cross-functional teams.

Why This Role?

  • Opportunity to build and scale a business-critical customer experience from an early stage.
  • End-to-end ownership across fulfillment, delivery promise, post-order journeys, and supporting platforms.
  • High visibility with leadership and significant impact on customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Chance to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing commerce business within Nykaa.

Skills

- Strong product thinking and execution skills.
- Ability to navigate ambiguity and build products from first principles.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Why This Role?

- Opportunity to build and scale a business-critical customer experience from an early stage.

- High visibility with leadership and significant impact on customer experience and business outcomes.
- Chance to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing commerce business within Nykaa.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – E-commerce to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of innovative digital commerce products. In this role, you will own key customer-facing and business-critical initiatives, working closely with engineering, design, marketing, operations, and leadership teams to deliver seamless shopping experiences and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in e-commerce product management, customer-centric thinking, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to execute complex product initiatives from concept to launch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for e-commerce platforms and customer experiences.
  • Drive end-to-end product lifecycle management, from ideation and requirements gathering to launch and continuous optimization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to deliver high-impact product features.
  • Analyze customer behavior, market trends, and competitive landscapes to identify growth opportunities.
  • Improve key business metrics such as conversion rate, customer retention, average order value (AOV), and customer lifetime value (CLTV).
  • Prioritize product backlogs based on business impact, customer needs, and technical feasibility.
  • Define product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for development teams.
  • Lead A/B testing, experimentation, and data analysis to validate product hypotheses.
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of product initiatives.
  • Monitor product performance using analytics tools and continuously optimize the customer journey.
  • Align product strategy with overall business objectives while ensuring exceptional user experiences

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job Purpose

The purpose of this job is to facilitate smooth internal audit and implement control effectiveness frameworks within operation function so as to ensure that the key process, system and file & use risks of the organisation are identified mitigated and controls are established. Also to facilitate closure of the open audit observations for all verticals in Operations and for vendors so as to effectively participate process control environment of the organization.

Job Context & Major Challenges

Job Context: The purpose of this job is to facilitate smooth internal audit and implement control effectiveness frameworks within operation function so as to ensure that the key process, system and file & use risks of the organisation are identified mitigated and controls are established. Also to facilitate closure of the open audit observations for all verticals in Operations and for vendors so as to effectively participate process control environment of the organization.

Job Challenges:

  • In a recessionary period or otherwise it is utmost important to look at the operations internally and look at how processes work. Improve the existing processes that could lead to potential downfall and create financial risk for the organisation and to the regulatory agency which can affect the day to day operations.
  • Coordinating with different Functions – with a view to integrate a smooth functioning of the various operations department and provide a birds eye view of the whole gamut of processes applicable to Polad, New Business, Claims, UW, Group Ops, Customer Service, Zonal Operations and vendors
  • Implementation of any regulatory requirements across the business
  • Compliance with the data / reports requirements for the operations team as specified by regulator/ regulatory intermediaries
  • To integrate external vendors with respect to process requirements of the organisation and help them mitigate risk & comply with the procedures as specified or agreed upon
  • Provide training to all stake holders on key process
  • Conceptualising, designing processes and implementing the same to mitigate risk (operational as well as financial) and potential fraud that will be avoided. Strengthen the existing systems and process on the basis of experience with the operations domain
  • In the current scenario, where business is in its growth phase, controls are all the more
  • imperative and that in itself is a challenge
  • To ensure that controls are implemented across the board. To liaise with various units like Compliance, Finance, sales, actuary etc.

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 To ensure internal audit for Operations which includes Polad, New Business, Claims, UW, Group Ops, Customer Service, Zonal Operations and vendors is smoothly conducted 1. Facilitate in defining the scope of internal audit for Operations such as Polad, New Business, Claims, UW, Group Ops and Customer Service

  • Data Sharing for internal audit review which contains query designing and data extraction from data base
  • Facilitate in vendor audits
  • Submission of Management responses
  • Finalization of risk ranking and functional sign off of the audit report from COO
  • Ensuring monthly audit updates are provided and open points are closed with evidences within target date
  • Preparation and submission of Audit committee actionable

KRA2 To close open audit observations for Operations which includes Polad, New Business, Claims, UW, Group Ops, Customer Service, Zonal Operations and vendors is done with satisfactory evidences as decided by audit committee and internal audit team 1. To send out reminders at set frequencies

  • Facilitate closure in collaboration with teams
  • Facilitate vertical head and function head approval as desired
  • Conduct review of internal controls for the closed observations

KRA3 To ensure adherence w.r.to IRDA regulations, Insurance Act and AML-for Operations which includes Polad, New Business, Claims, UW, Group Ops, Customer Service, Zonal Operations and vendors 1. Quarterly data submission to IRDA

  • Quarterly data submission to accounts to ensure periodic disclosure; L-39, L-40 and L-41
  • New/Amendments circular implementation/role of regulatory champion
  • Facilitate regulatory audit for operations in nature of onsite inspection, data submission and audit observation-responses submission
  • KYC versions implementations
  • Ad hoc data submission to regulators/statutory bodies such as IRDA, Parliament, economic wings, CBI, Ministry of Finance

KRA4 To ensure regulation on file and use is met and deviation on product specification is minimised or nil so as to ensure strategies for such key enterprise risk mitigation is in place and ensure timely submission of Risk management committee actionable. 1. Preparation and submission of Risk Management committee actionable

  • Carry out the product specification deviation analysis of function / team and report the operational losses (if any) to Risk Team,
  • Facilitate for rectification process of errors
  • Liaising with Risk Management in design of any new processes, systems and key procedures so that risk issues are addressed proactively and not as an afterthought
  • Facilitate to avail Key risk updates of the function
  • Monitoring of outsourcing vendor performance report
  • Review of ICP/RR policy

KRA5 To ensure outsourcing policies is adhered and all SLA is met in with regards to said regulation for all vendor operation team is associated to. 1. Adherence to the Outsourcing policies

  • Timely closure of Vendor Audit reports
  • Quality checks/OFEs on outsourced process
  • Feedback to VMG and assurance on implementation

KRA6 Imparting training to the teams so as to ensure standardized processes. 1. Ensuring adequate training to stakeholders on the areas of

  • Audits
  • Regulatory compliance
  • Risk Management and Outsourcing
  • Process adherence
  • IRDA Circulars/press release

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.


Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.




AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.


Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.




Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams – Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official ‘name@cvent.com’ email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud


In this Role, you will:


Strategic Product Leadership

  • Own your domain roadmap tied to measurable OKRs—define strategy, drive outcomes, and hold the line on scope discipline.
  • Run structured Problem & Solution Discovery before committing to build; validate with leadership, customers, and cross-functional partners.
  • Drive Go-To-Market readiness end-to-end: from inception through launch, adoption, and post-release success measurement.

AI-First Product Thinking

  • Embed AI as a default lens across every phase of product management—champion AI-native processes within your team.
  • Own end-to-end development of AI-powered features, including evals and measurable outcome tracking.
  • Leverage AI tooling to improve your PM workflow; model and share productivity gains with the broader team.
  • Participate in AI forums; work toward defining team-level AI processes and contributing sessions or case studies.
  • Ensure all AI features meet Cvent's responsible AI standards.

Execution Excellence & Platform Health

  • Drive delivery accountability: sprint hygiene, backlog depth health, SLI/SLO monitoring, and prod bug leakage.
  • Define strategy to reach OKRs, NPS, and key product metrics; socialize alignment to business goals with leadership.
  • Make data-driven prioritization decisions using Mixpanel, ProductBoard, Sigma, and similar platforms.
  • Write crisp, unambiguous product specs and user stories with full acceptance criteria before sprint start.

Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions in your domain; own escalation paths and surface deviations proactively.
  • Lead multi-stakeholder alignment across Sales, CS, Engineering, UX, and Leadership—with 360° feedback collected mid-year and annually.
  • Present roadmap progress and risks clearly to leadership; no stakeholder should be chasing you for an update.
  • Influence without authority—build alignment at all levels of the organization through trust, clarity, and data.

People Development & Team Capability

  • Mentor junior PMs through structured 1:1s, skill development plans, and goal alignment—hold the bar on accountability.
  • Build AI competency within your squad: assess baseline, design a learning path, and track adoption.
  • Identify and create stretch opportunities for high performers; drive adoption of Cvent processes and tools.
  • Contribute to improvements and a culture of continuous learning within the PM org.


Here's what you need:


  • 12–15 years of experience with 7+ years in product management for technology products.
  • Demonstrated experience building or shipping AI-powered products; hands-on proficiency with AI tools is required.
  • Proficiency with analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Gainsight PX, Pendo, or similar) to measure and drive adoption.
  • Strong product sense: can define strategy, articulate the "why," and translate ambiguity into clear roadmaps.
  • Solid grasp of software development, integrations, and system design—able to earn deep technical credibility.
  • Track record of mentoring PMs and elevating team capability, not just individual execution.
  • Exceptional communicator and influencer—comfortable driving alignment across C-suite, engineering, and customers.
  • Analytical, data-driven, and energized by complexity in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Company:

At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

Payments are foundational to the success of every business on Playlist. As we continue to expand globally and invest in new fintech capabilities, we're building shared platform capabilities that improve reliability, accelerate innovation, and create seamless payment experiences across our products.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help define the future of payments at Playlist. This role sits at the intersection of platform strategy, payments infrastructure, customer experience, and business growth. You'll work across multiple product lines, markets, and stakeholder groups to create scalable capabilities that help teams move faster while delivering better outcomes for merchants and consumers.

The Role You'll Play

This is a senior individual contributor role where you'll lead through influence, product judgment, and execution excellence. You'll shape shared payments capabilities that support critical business needs today while building the foundation for long-term scale, reliability, and global growth.

  • Define the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for shared payments capabilities across Playlist
  • Identify opportunities to create leverage through common platforms, clear ownership models, and thoughtful trade-offs
  • Lead the evolution of core payments platform capabilities, including payment processing, partner integrations, reliability, scalability, reporting, and future platform expansion
  • Partner closely with Engineering to evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and prioritize platform investments that create lasting business value
  • Own the strategy for shared payment experiences across products and markets, with a focus on conversion, trust, accessibility, and ease of adoption
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Finance, Operations, Risk, GTM, and Product leaders to align priorities and deliver business-critical initiatives
  • Drive adoption of shared capabilities by building trust, clarifying trade-offs, and demonstrating measurable business impact.
  • Partner with product teams across Playlist to ensure platform investments translate into measurable improvements in merchant and consumer experiences
  • Establish frameworks, principles, and operating mechanisms that improve product and payments decision-making across the organization

Experience You Bring

  • 10+ years of Product Management experience, with significant ownership of platform products, payments products, fintech experiences, or other technically complex domains
  • Deep understanding of payments ecosystems, including payment processing, authorization, settlement, reconciliation, disputes, partner relationships, and operational considerations
  • Experience building shared capabilities that multiple teams have successfully adopted across products, markets, or business areas
  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to reason through complex dependencies, trade-offs, integrations, APIs, architecture, and technical constraints
  • Proven ability to partner with Engineering and Design to create customer experiences that balance technical excellence, trust, accessibility, and business outcomes
  • Clear communication skills, with experience aligning stakeholders, building consensus, and simplifying complex topics for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Track record of delivering meaningful business outcomes in ambiguous, high-impact environments
  • Experience with international products, payments, regulatory requirements, or multi-market launches is a plus

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success is measured by your ability to:

  • Deliver scalable platform capabilities that accelerate innovation across products
  • Improve payment performance, reliability, and customer experience
  • Drive adoption of shared capabilities across teams and business areas
  • Balance customer needs, technical investments, and business outcomes
  • Create alignment across diverse stakeholders and functions.
  • Improve merchant and consumer experiences by reducing friction across critical payment journeys
  • Establish a strong foundation for future growth and expansion

This is an opportunity to shape the future of payments at Playlist while working on some of the most strategically important initiatives across the company.

Have we piqued your curiosity?

Sound like the role for you? We’d love to hear from you! Even if you’re not 100% sure about potential fit, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for the right person, not the perfect series of checkboxes.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We highly value diversity at our company and encourage people of all different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics.

By entering your email and phone number and submitting your application, you consent to receive emails, calls and SMS about your application and other roles at The Company, including by auto-dialer. Message and data rates may apply. Opt-out or text STOP to cancel at any time. If you are a California resident or reside outside the United States then by submitting your application you confirm that you have read, understood, agree and - where applicable - grant your prior, free, informed and express consent for the processing of your personal information, including sensitive personal information, as described in our California Applicant Privacy Notice or International Applicant Privacy Notice (as applicable).

Note: This description outlines key responsibilities but isn’t intended to cover every task or duty. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed to support the team and business goals.

You'll work across multiple product lines, markets, and stakeholder groups to create scalable capabilities that help teams move faster while delivering better outcomes for merchants and consumers.

The Role You'll Play

This is a senior individual contributor role where you'll lead through influence, product judgment, and execution excellence. You'll shape shared payments capabilities that support critical business needs today while building the foundation for long-term scale, reliability, and global growth.



-  Define the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for shared payments capabilities across Playlist
-  Identify opportunities to create leverage through common platforms, clear ownership models, and thoughtful trade-offs
-  Lead the evolution of core payments platform capabilities, including payment processing, partner integrations, reliability, scalability, reporting, and future platform expansion
-  Partner closely with Engineering to evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and prioritize platform investments that create lasting business value
-  Own the strategy for shared payment experiences across products and markets, with a focus on conversion, trust, accessibility, and ease of adoption
-  Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Finance, Operations, Risk, GTM, and Product leaders to align priorities and deliver business-critical initiatives
-  Drive adoption of shared capabilities by building trust, clarifying trade-offs, and demonstrating measurable business impact.
-  Partner with product teams across Playlist to ensure platform investments translate into measurable improvements in merchant and consumer experiences
-  Establish frameworks, principles, and operating mechanisms that improve product and payments decision-making across the organization

Experience You Bring



-  10+ years of Product Management experience, with significant ownership of platform products, payments products, fintech experiences, or other technically complex domains
-  Deep understanding of payments ecosystems, including payment processing, authorization, settlement, reconciliation, disputes, partner relationships, and operational considerations
-  Experience building shared capabilities that multiple teams have successfully adopted across products, markets, or business areas
-  Strong systems thinking, with the ability to reason through complex dependencies, trade-offs, integrations, APIs, architecture, and technical constraints
-  Proven ability to partner with Engineering and Design to create customer experiences that balance technical excellence, trust, accessibility, and business outcomes
-  Clear communication skills, with experience aligning stakeholders, building consensus, and simplifying complex topics for technical and non-technical audiences
-  Track record of delivering meaningful business outcomes in ambiguous, high-impact environments
-  Experience with international products, payments, regulatory requirements, or multi-market launches is a plus

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success is measured by your ability to:



-  Deliver scalable platform capabilities that accelerate innovation across products
-  Improve payment performance, reliability, and customer experience
-  Drive adoption of shared capabilities across teams and business areas
-  Balance customer needs, technical investments, and business outcomes
-  Create alignment across diverse stakeholders and functions.
-  Improve merchant and consumer experiences by reducing friction across critical payment journeys
-  Establish a strong foundation for future growth and expansion

This is an opportunity to shape the future of payments at Playlist while working on some of the most strategically important initiatives across the company.

Have we piqued your curiosity?

Sound like the role for you? We’d love to hear from you! Even if you’re not 100% sure about potential fit, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for the right person, not the perfect series of checkboxes.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We highly value diversity at our company and encourage people of all different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics.

By entering your email and phone number and submitting your application, you consent to receive emails, calls and SMS about your application and other roles at The Company, including by auto-dialer. Message and data rates may apply. Opt-out or text STOP to cancel at any time. If you are a California resident or reside outside the United States then by submitting your application you confirm that you have read, understood, agree and - where applicable - grant your prior, free, informed and express consent for the processing of your personal information, including sensitive personal information, as described in our California Applicant Privacy Notice or International Applicant Privacy Notice (as applicable).

Note: This description outlines key responsibilities but isn’t intended to cover every task or duty. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed to support the team and business goals.

title: Sr Product Manager - AI Innovations | India
descriptionHtml:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly entrepreneurial, driven Senior Product Manager to lead the charge on our next-generation AI Insights solutions. In this 0-to-1 role, you will operate with scrappy, startup-minded velocity within the stability and scale of a mid-sized enterprise environment.

You will not just be managing a roadmap; you will be building a product from the ground up that leverages machine learning and AI to deliver actionable, transformative insights to contact center operations. You are comfortable navigating the messiness of real-world data and the limitations of ML models in production, making tough tradeoff calls with incomplete information, and pivoting quickly when things aren't working.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Execution

  • Define and execute the 0-to-1 product strategy for Five9's AI-powered insights and analytics offerings

Navigate Ambiguity

  • Handle real-world data complexities, manage ML model limitations in production environments, and make critical product decisions even when data is incomplete

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner deeply with Engineering, Applied Science/ML, Design, and GTM functions to deliver superior products for our customers

Customer-Centric Iteration

  • Actively engage with customers and design partners to gather feedback, validate assumptions, and refine the product roadmap based on real-world usage and pain points

Market Leadership

  • Conduct competitive research and market analysis to identify new opportunities in AI/ML analytics and maintain a competitive edge

Ruthless Prioritization

  • Demonstrate a builder's instinct with strong opinions, loosely held. Know when to double down and possess a track record of confidently killing features or pivoting strategies that aren't working

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • MBA or Master’s in Data Science, Analytics, or related degrees is a plus

Professional Experience

  • 4+ years of comprehensive professional experience in SaaS Product Management
  • The ideal candidate will demonstrate adaptability and success across both agile, high-growth startup environments and established enterprise organizations

Product Leadership

  • A proven track record in a formal Product Management capacity, successfully delivering B2B SaaS solutions

Industry Expertise (Required)

  • Essential background in the Contact Center or Customer Experience (CX) industry coupled with direct experience building and shipping AI-driven products

Technical Acumen

  • Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle for ML-driven solutions, including data collection, model training tradeoffs, and analytics

Execution-Oriented

  • A highly autonomous operator capable of driving initiatives forward without relying on extensive operational support structures
  • Must be able to articulate and defend strategic decisions effectively and collaboratively

Critical Competencies

Successful candidates for this role will demonstrate:

Applied AI Proficiency

  • Practical experience managing the realities of LLMs and machine learning deployments, including addressing latency constraints, optimization, and accuracy challenges

Operational Excellence

  • A strong bias for action and a proven ability to translate high-level strategy into tangible, delivered products

Client Advocacy

  • A strong commitment to direct customer interaction and a willingness to engage continuously with clients to resolve challenges, gather feedback, and drive product adoption

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

title: Product Lead – AI-Powered RCM Dashboard
descriptionHtml:
Product Lead – AI-Powered RCM Dashboard


Employment Type: Full-Time or Part-Time

Company: Healthpoint Ventures


About Healthpoint Ventures


Healthpoint Ventures is building the next generation of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) intelligence for healthcare providers and health systems. Our mission is to transform how healthcare organizations understand, manage, and optimize revenue through AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, and actionable insights.


We are developing a modern, AI-first RCM Dashboard that gives healthcare leaders unprecedented visibility into financial performance, operational bottlenecks, denials, collections, payer behavior, and revenue opportunities.


We are looking for a Product Lead who deeply understands Revenue Cycle Management and has hands-on experience building and managing RCM products.


⸻


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Product Lead – RCM Dashboard to own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for our AI-powered Revenue Cycle Management platform.


This is not a generic product management role. The ideal candidate must have significant experience in the healthcare revenue cycle domain and have previously served as a Product Manager or Product Lead for an RCM-focused product, platform, or healthcare financial operations solution.


You will work closely with healthcare operators, engineering teams, AI/ML teams, and leadership to build a category-defining product for health systems.


⸻


What You’ll Do


* Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our AI-powered RCM Dashboard.

* Translate complex healthcare revenue cycle workflows into intuitive product experiences.

* Build products that provide actionable insights across:

  * Claims management

  * Denials management

  * Accounts receivable (AR)

  * Payment posting

  * Eligibility and authorization

  * Charge capture

  * Payer performance

  * Revenue leakage detection

  * Collections optimization

* Partner with healthcare operators and customers to deeply understand pain points and workflow requirements.

* Work closely with engineering, design, data science, and AI teams to deliver high-impact features.

* Define product requirements, success metrics, and go-to-market priorities.

* Leverage AI and analytics to surface insights, recommendations, and workflow automation opportunities.

* Stay current with industry trends, payer dynamics, regulatory changes, and RCM best practices.


⸻


Required Qualifications


Must-Have


* 5+ years of Product Management experience.

* Direct experience managing or leading an RCM (Revenue Cycle Management) product.

* Deep understanding of end-to-end healthcare revenue cycle operations.

* Strong knowledge of:

  * Claims lifecycle

  * Denials workflows

  * AR management

  * Payer processes

  * Revenue integrity

  * Healthcare financial operations

* Experience working with healthcare providers, health systems, RCM companies, or healthcare technology platforms.

* Proven ability to translate domain expertise into successful product outcomes.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


Highly Preferred


* Experience building analytics, dashboarding, or operational intelligence products.

* Experience with AI/ML-powered healthcare products.

* Familiarity with EHR, Practice Management, and RCM systems.

* Experience working with US healthcare providers and payer ecosystems.

* Background in healthcare SaaS or health-tech startups.


⸻


What Success Looks Like


* Delivering a best-in-class AI-powered RCM Dashboard used by healthcare leaders.

* Helping health systems identify revenue leakage and operational inefficiencies.

* Building actionable intelligence that improves collections, reduces denials, and accelerates cash flow.

* Creating a product that becomes the command center for healthcare revenue operations.


⸻


Why Join Healthpoint Ventures


* Opportunity to build a category-defining healthcare AI product from the ground up.

* Work directly with experienced healthcare and technology leaders.

* High ownership and autonomy.

* Flexible engagement model (Full-Time or Part-Time).

* Competitive compensation based on experience.


  • If you have built RCM products before and understand the nuances of healthcare revenue cycle operations, we’d love to talk.

title: Senior Product Manager - AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Life at EvoluteIQ


We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building a industry-leading Technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business.


To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self-driven, and collaborative.

People who not only want to be a part of a fast-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and caring—about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day.


Could that be you?


Your Mission

Our culture is who we are, and it defines us. We are nimble, fast, dedicated, humble, and bold. We see opportunities everywhere around us to make a “dent in the universe”. Our core fabric is Innovation!


And this is not just a word, but the way of life within EvoluteIQ.


Changing the way business is done, reimagining the future of work, and enabling people to improve their quality of work every day, is a daunting task. That is what we all strive for every day at EvoluteIQ.


To enable everyone to automate complicated processes with their instinct and knowledge. We make the building of automations implemented for everyone, so that it is not a mystery for a few.


Would you like to join us on this journey?


We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our AI/ML feature within our platform. This role requires strong prior experience in AI/ML product development in a product-based environment, with at least 10+ years of hands on- product management experience.


What you'll do at EvoluteIQ:


End-to-End Feature Ownership

  • Own the complete lifecycle of AI/ML features from ideation to production release.
  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, engineering, and data science teams.
  • Drive roadmap definition, prioritization, and delivery planning for AI/ML capabilities.
  • Ensure delivered features meet business objectives, quality benchmarks, and user needs.
  • Drive post release- assessment and iteration based on usage data and feedback.


Research & Requirements Gathering

  • Conduct research on AI/ML industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs.
  • Identify high-value use cases and business opportunities across domains.
  • Work closely with internal/external stakeholders to understand business problems and define scope.
  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable functional requirements and success metrics.
  • Evaluate feasibility, impact, and business value of proposed AI/ML features.
  • Stay informed about developments in Generative AI, LLMs, and emerging tools.


Documentation & Communication

  • Create comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), functional specifications, and workflows.
  • Write detailed user stories with acceptance criteria and test scenarios.
  • Maintain documentation on feature scope, functionality, limitations, design decisions, and usage guidelines.
  • Present feature proposals, roadmap updates, and delivery progress to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Ensure alignment of product expectations across technical and business teams.


Engineering & Delivery Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, data science, UX, DevOps, QA, and architecture teams to deliver high quality- features.
  • Ensure seamless integration of AI/ML workflows and model lifecycle management.
  • Partner with data science to assess model fit, evaluation metrics, and deployment readiness.
  • Support delivery planning, grooming, sprint execution, and release cycles.
  • Coordinate go-to- market activities, enablement, and user training


What will you bring to the team?


  • 12+ years of hands-on product management experience, with proven ownership of AI/ML or GenAI product areas.
  • Prior experience working in a product company is mandatory.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • ML lifecycle, inference, evaluations
  • MLOps processes, Data engineering concepts
  • LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering
  • Strong documentation skills — PRDs, user stories, specs, and roadmaps.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and data science teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management.
  • Experience with agile methodologies.


Good To Have:

  • Experience with low-code/no-code platforms or enterprise workflow systems.
  • Experience running experiments (A/B testing) or evaluating GenAI/ML models.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to shape the strategy of a next-gen hyper-automation platform.
  • Work with a cross-disciplinary team in a fast-growing, innovation-driven environment.
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.
  • A culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.


We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes.

Angara E-Commerce Private Limited is a luxury jewellery e-commerce company founded in the year 2007. It is a subsidiary of the American company, Angara Inc., which is headquartered in Los Angeles, California. Over the last few years, Angara has grown exponentially, establishing itself as a global leader in handcrafted colored gemstone as well as diamond jewellery. Our luxury jewellery is shipped to more than 65 countries worldwide, and has a presence in the United States of America, Bangkok, Australia, Canada, and the United Kingdom. In India, our offices are located in Jaipur and Noida.

Angara was ranked the No.1 Online Jeweller in the US in 2020 by the leading American magazine, Newsweek. We were also recognized by Newsweek as 5 Year Champion on being voted among the best online jewellers in its list of “Best Online Shops” for five years in a row. That’s not all. Our ground-breaking innovation, ‘Create with Angara,’ earned us the Business Intelligence Group’s 2024 BIG Innovation Award as well as the #10 spot in Retail on Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2024 list. In addition to this, we secured the prestigious Bizrate Insights Circle of Excellence Award for two consecutive years as well as the Business Intelligence Excellence in Customer Service Award 2023. Better Business Bureau has rated Angara A+ for excellence in service and our Trust Pilot rating stands at 4.5 out of 5.


We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – AI to build and scale AI-native, personalization-first D2C experiences across the customer lifecycle.

You will lead recommendation systems, CDP-driven decisioning, and agentic customer journeys, leveraging AI/ML and Generative AI to drive conversion, retention, and revenue growth.

Operating at the intersection of product, data science, and growth, you will act as a horizontal AI layer across customer funnels while driving AI-led operational efficiencies.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Personalization & Recommendations

  • Own end-to-end personalization across web and app
  • Build and optimize recommendation and real-time decisioning systems
  • Drive impact on various business matrix including Conversion, AOV, RPV, LTV and contribution margin and more


2. AI, Gen AI & Agentic Systems

  • Act as the horizontal AI layer across funnel experiences with CX teams
  • Build AI use cases across:
  • Content generation, discovery, and conversational commerce
  • Develop agentic systems for journey orchestration, nudges, and guided selling
  • Integrate LLM workflows across search, recommendations, and support
  • Drive a lightweight AI innovation pipeline to prototype and scale new use cases


3. D2C Funnel & Growth

  • Own the end-to-end funnel (Acquisition → Retention)
  • Optimize cart, checkout, pricing, and promotions using AI
  • Improve CAC, LTV, and funnel efficiency


4. Data, CDP & Experimentation

  • Leverage CDPs to activate customer data and real-time triggers
  • Drive A/B testing and experimentation at scale
  • Track key metrics useful for business
  • Continuously optimize using data and AI insights


5. AI Workflows & Operational Efficiency

  • Build AI-driven automation and copilots across merchandising, marketing ops, and support
  • Streamline workflows (content, tagging, QA, campaigns)
  • Drive efficiency, speed, and cost optimization


6. Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Growth, and CX teams
  • Translate AI capabilities into scalable products and business outcomes
  • Own roadmap and execution


7. Responsible AI

  • Ensure ethical, compliant, and explainable AI systems


Skills, Tools & Background

  • Strong in data analysis and experimentation (SQL required; Python preferred)
  • Experience with analytics and A/B testing tools (Omniture, Power BI, GA, Mixpanel, Amplitude, etc.)
  • Experience building AI/ML-powered products (personalization, search, automation) and Gen AI/LLMs
  • Familiarity with CDPs, APIs, and data pipelines
  • Awareness of RAG, embeddings, vector databases is a plus
  • Hands-on in prototyping and AI workflow tools
  • Proven ability to analyze data, run experiments, and drive impact
  • Strong builder mindset—prototype, test, and scale


Experience & Education

  • 5+ years in Product Management
  • Experience in AI/ML, personalization and Gen AI related products
  • Background in D2C / consumer tech / high-scale platforms preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; AI/ML coursework is a plus



If your profile resonate with JD & you're open to work at Jaipur location, Please email your CV - nirpesh.jindal@angara.com

Meet Our Team:

As a Senior Product Manager at Pega, you will own and drive critical cloud platform and developer experience capabilities that power a large-scale, enterprise SaaS platform. You will work at the intersection of Cloud, Platform, Product and Operations, and developer tooling, translating complex technical challenges into clear product outcomes that improve platform resilience, scalability, and deployment predictability.

This role is a high-impact individual contributor position, central to delivering reliable, automated, and enterprise-grade cloud platform services used by internal engineering teams and global enterprise customers.

Picture Yourself At Pega:

You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, and operations teams to ensure platform capabilities are not just built, but are intuitive, reliable, and scalable—supporting frictionless experiences across build, deploy, and operate lifecycles.

At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.

We expect you to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

What You'll Do At Pega:

  • Set product strategy using data-driven decisions by defining a clear cloud platform vision and roadmap, grounding priorities and trade-offs in platform metrics, customer feedback, and business outcomes.
  • Design for scale and long-term resilience by balancing near-term delivery with multi-tenant scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery needs across a large enterprise SaaS platform.
  • Drive platform reliability through measurable outcomes, owning availability, recovery, and operational readiness KPIs and partnering with engineering and operations to deliver automated, testable, and scalable solutions.
  • Enable safe change at scale by leading deployment orchestration, governance, and automation strategies that reduce risk, eliminate manual toil, and support predictable releases across environments.
  • Champion intuitive developer and operator experiences by improving end-to-end workflows and ensuring platform capabilities surface as clear, actionable, and productivity-enhancing experiences.
  • Execute through Agile and strong cross-functional collaboration, acting as Product Owner, prioritizing the backlog, and communicating product decisions, progress, and trade-offs clearly to engineering teams and senior stakeholders.

Who You Are:

  • You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
  • You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You've Accomplished:

  • 12+ years of experience in Technical Development and Architectural roles across Cloud solutions and 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, Platform Product Management, or similar roles.
  • Experience building or owning cloud, platform, or developer-facing products
  • Strong understanding of Agile product development and Product Owner responsibilities
  • Proven ability to work with distributed, cross-functional engineering teams and influence at scale
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, outcome-focused manner

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or equivalents)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment orchestration, reliability engineering, or cloud operations
  • Familiarity with infrastructure, control plane, or shared platform services
  • Strong data-driven mindset with a focus on measurable impact

Pega Offers You:

  • Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities
  • An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
  • Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
