title: Agentic Search, Sr. Platform Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an impact-driven, Senior Product Manager within our AI Products and Insights team, to lead our Next-Gen Agentic Search Platform, powering content discovery, and downstream AI experiences across the enterprise, including AskGartner.

In this role, you will own the product strategy and evolution of the platform that determines how content is ingested, enriched, indexed, retrieved, and served across the enterprise. You will help modernize our search stack by advancing lexical and vector retrieval capabilities, while ensuring the platform integrates effectively with emerging agentic and LLM-based orchestration patterns.

You will work at the intersection of search, AI, and platform product management, shaping a foundational capability used by multiple downstream teams and products. This is an opportunity to solve deep technical product problems, influence platform architecture, and drive broad enterprise impact in a complex, fast-evolving ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery for Agentic Search Platform, aligning priorities to enterprise AI strategy, client use-cases, and downstream product needs.
  • Lead platform transformation initiatives, including migration from Solr to OpenSearch, integration with modern Agentic patterns and LLM-orchestration frameworks, while maintaining continuity for downstream consumers.
  • Define and evolve end-to-end indexing strategy and retrieval architecture, including pipelines for ingestion, enrichment, indexing, to better leverage diverse and evolving enterprise content sources.
  • Drive measurable improvements to ranking and relevance through AI/ML-based retrieval and reranking approaches (e.g., learning-to-rank, semantic retrieval, hybrid search patterns), improving precision/recall, engagement, and core experience metrics.
  • Establish a rigorous evaluation framework and guardrails for Search platform performance, including relevancy, latency, reliability, and scalability, and use those insights to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
  • Enable downstream teams by building robust, well-defined Search APIs and services, and platform abstractions that reduce friction and accelerate development across surfaces.
  • Expand platform adoption by bringing Search capabilities to new domains and product surfaces, increasing enterprise-wide leverage.
  • Own cross-functional coordination and communication—driving alignment across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and dependent teams, and managing complex dependencies in a fast-paced environment.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Background

  • 5–7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful exposure to technical platforms and enterprise SaaS products.
  • Deep understanding of search and retrieval systems, including indexing strategies, metadata enrichment, retrieval workflows, ranking mechanisms, and modern search ecosystems (e.g., OpenSearch/Elasticsearch).
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases
  • Demonstrated experience working with AI/ML-powered relevance and ranking systems, with practical understanding of model tradeoffs, feature engineering, evaluation frameworks (offline metrics + online experimentation), and what it takes to operationalize these systems in production.
  • Track record of shipping technical products or platforms from zero-to-one and scaling them through adoption and iteration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to diagnose gaps in system behavior or output quality, and translate them into structured, high impact improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI-ML and system concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment.

Who You Are

  • Genuinely curious, you dig into problems because you want to understand them, not just resolve them. You read broadly, ask good questions, and notice things others miss.
  • Proactive and self-directed, you don’t wait for assignments. You see gaps, form a point of view, and move toward solutions before being asked.
  • Humble and learning-oriented, you’re comfortable saying “I don’t know” and genuinely excited to learn from the people around you, regardless of their title.
  • Sincere about the work, you care about building something meaningful, not just shipping features. You take pride in craft and hold yourself to a high standard because the work matters to you, not because someone is watching.
  • A clear, honest communicator, you can articulate complex tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences, and you default to transparency over spin.
  • Driven by impact, you measure your own success by whether the product got better and users got more value, not by how many things you launched.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you’ve operated in environments where the right answer wasn’t obvious and you had to develop conviction through experimentation and judgment.
  • Comfortable operating in 0-to-1 innovation environments: you can create structure where little exists, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and drive work from early discovery through initial launch.

Why This Role

  • Shape a product used by hundreds of thousands of enterprise decision-makers worldwide, with direct visibility into how your work moves business outcomes.
  • Work at the frontier of applied AI in enterprise, rethinking how humans interact with deep institutional knowledge.
  • Join a high-caliber, tight-knit product team that values rigorous thinking, intellectual honesty, and building things that matter.
  • Operate with real ownership: the team is small enough that your judgment directly shapes what gets built, and senior enough that your voice is heard in strategic conversations.
  • Learn and grow in an environment that invests in product management as a craft, with structured development, mentorship, and a culture of continuous improvement.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Client Technology -Senior Product Delivery Manager
descriptionHtml:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

CT Senior Product Delivery Manager - Associate Director

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help build a better working world.

The opportunity

The selected candidate will

  • The Senior Product Delivery Manager will bring a strong understanding of modern software engineering principles and architecture. While not expected to code daily, the TPM should have prior experience working closely with engineers, solution architects, and data specialists. They will able to translate complex technical concepts into actionable deliverables.
  • Be responsible for identifying, handling and executing product strategies for their function
  • The Senior PDM will interact with individuals up to the Partner rank socializing, identifying and recommending products
  • This role is a primary contact and lead for all product aspects including strategy, user experience design, development, and deployment
  • The role will continuously evaluate and validate product vision to anticipate and address changing business and user needs
  • The role has accountability for value delivery and budget adherence. Ensuring that resources, services, and delivery outcomes align with agreed value metrics and budget parameters.
  • This role is responsible for helping to find opportunities for products to align to the firm’s broader organizational mission and strategy and that it is competitively positioned driving revenue and EY’s technological footprint in the market
  • This role will require a solid understanding of Azure-based architectures, data and AI platforms (e.g., Databricks, M365 integrations), and modern DevOps practices to ensure effective collaboration across globally distributed development teams.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Within large projects, define and maintain realistic delivery plans, ensuring disciplined software lifecycle management across analysis, design, development, testing, and release. Drive adherence to quality gates, change control, and CI/CD processes.
  • This position is a leadership position responsible for defining the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a sophisticated product or a set of products within a product family
  • Manage a mid-size team of product professionals, as well as roles across a software delivery lifecycle, such as architects, engineers, scrum masters etc
  • Provide matrix leadership and coaching to Business Analysts to ensure user stories are well-structured, technically feasible, and meet Definition of Ready and Definition of Done standards. Establish and enforce story quality standards and backlog readiness criteria.
  • This leadership position is responsible for thought leadership ensuring the product supports the organization’s overall strategy and goals
  • Outstanding leadership with the ability to communicate the vision and goals of the product, product family, and offerings
  • Drive strategy development, establish priorities and manage the roadmap using criteria and requirements defined during research
  • Act as the customer advocate articulating the user’s and/or buyer’s needs
  • Work closely with engineering, sales, marketing, and support to ensure business case and customer satisfaction goals are met
  • Have technical product knowledge or specific domain expertise
  • Define what to solve in the market needs document, where you articulate the valuable market problem you’re solving along with priorities and justification for each part of the solution
  • Align with business teams on MVP requirements, run beta and pilot programs during the qualify phase
  • In Agile environments, regularly reviews completed work and checks with customers to ensure that it meets the customer expectations
  • Is a market professional. Market expertise includes understanding the reasons customers purchase products. This includes a deep understanding of the competition, and how customers think of and buy your product. Product Managers need market research and competitive analysis skills to complete these tasks
  • Acts as the product’s leader within the company
  • Develops the business case for new products, improvements to existing products, and business ventures
  • Responsible for the development and positioning of 2-3 mid-size products or 1 large enterprise product that is global with responsibility for sophisticated customization. These products enable critical internal capabilities across the firm, supporting operational excellence and technology modernization objectives.
  • Recommends or requires an awareness of competitive pricing to understand how pricing impacts product profit margin compared to competition
  • Execute the product plan, collaborating with product owner, engineering and other teams
  • Translate architectural direction into incremental deliverables. Lead technical discovery and spike activities to reduce delivery risk and accelerate time-to-value. Work closely with solution architects to ensure technical feasibility and alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Demonstrate functionality of completed products to partners
  • Develop metrics to assess the success of products and features and resolve vital enhancements
  • Anticipate changes in market dynamics/models, adapts products, and creates product retirement and transitioning strategies
  • Identify new products and features to create growth opportunities

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • A strong understanding of software engineering lifecycle principles, DevOps pipelines, and Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe) is essential. The TPM must be able to assess technical risks, interpret architecture decisions, and translate them into clear, testable, and deliverable work items.
  • Manage the product lifecycle including market requirements, product release plans, user stories, release criteria, product launch, and organizational readiness activities
  • Collect business and technical input to define and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with architecture and platform capabilities. Partner with the BPM and engineering to continuously refine and sequence backlog items for efficient sprint execution
  • Partner with internal customers to validate requirements and priorities through various forums (analysis, meetings, focus groups, etc) and refine those requirements for broad market applicability
  • Collaborate with user experience, business analysts and engineers with a focus on defining product functionality and designing solutions that bring differentiating value to our current and prospective clients
  • Supervise market changes and trends to assess competitive positioning and opportunities for strategic product enhancements
  • Provide regular updates about product direction and release plans to the senior partners and clients
  • Monitor and report on delivery metrics such as lead time, user story cycle time, bug density, and mean time to restore service (MTTR) to ensure delivery health and continuous improvement.

What We Look For

A technically fluent, outcome-driven product leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to engage deeply in delivery detail. Someone who can coach teams, manage complex technical dependencies, and drive clarity between business intent and engineering execution

A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition and passion!

Preferred Certifications And Experience

  • Microsoft Azure or other cloud certifications (e.g., AZ-900, AZ-104, or equivalent)
  • Professional Product Management (e.g., SAFe POPM, CSPO, PSPO)
  • Agile or DevOps certifications (e.g., Scrum Master, DevOps Foundation)
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, GitHub, and CI/CD pipelines for software delivery

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

About The Role

HackerRank's goal is straightforward: to give companies a dependable way to evaluate whether a candidate can do the job. The previous model, which relied on test cases and code correctness, is becoming less reliable as candidates use AI assistants and produce work that requires deeper scrutiny.

The Evaluation team is rebuilding the underlying scoring system. This involves defining the new evaluation rubrics, determining how our models apply them consistently across thousands of candidates, working with enterprise clients to define good performance, and ensuring our methodology is fair and defensible.

Evaluation's trustworthiness is fundamental to HackerRank's business and its products. We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager to own this crucial charter.

What You Will Do

  • Own the evaluation product roadmap: what gets built, in what order, and why, with a clear point of view on what the product needs to become over the next 12 to 18 months.
  • Define what "good evaluation" means in product terms: the rubrics, scoring dimensions, bias safeguards, and consistency checks that enterprise customers will stake hiring decisions on.
  • Work directly with ML engineers and AI researchers to translate methodology into shipped product. You are the connective tissue between research clarity and engineering execution.
  • Talk to enterprise customers regularly. Understand how Goldman Sachs defines a strong candidate differently from how a startup does, and make sure the product can serve both.
  • Build the feedback loops that let the evaluation system improve: how we capture when customers disagree with a score, what signals we surface to the ML team, and how we close the loop.
  • Define and own the metrics that tell us whether evaluation quality is actually improving, not just whether we shipped something.

Who You Are

  • You have 5 or more years of product experience, with meaningful time in a B2B or enterprise context where your work had to be defensible to sophisticated customers.
  • You think rigorously about if the measures actually map to the outcomes. A PM who cannot tell the difference between a good metric and a vanity metric will not survive this role.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity in the problem definition. The answer to "what does good evaluation look like" does not exist yet. You need to want to find it, not wait for someone to hand it to you.
  • You can hold your own in a technical conversation with ML engineers without needing to code. You understand enough about model behavior, evaluation pipelines, and data feedback loops to ask sharp questions.
  • You communicate with precision. Crisp PRDs, sharp debate in design reviews, clear framing to customers and leadership. You do not hide behind vague language when the problem is hard.

Even better if you have

  • Prior experience in assessment, ed-tech, talent tech, or any domain where you had to build products around subjective or qualitative evaluation.
  • Exposure to fairness, bias, or compliance considerations in a product context.
  • Experience building or working closely with ML-powered scoring or ranking systems.
  • Track record of defining new product categories rather than iterating on established ones.

You will thrive if you

  • Believe the evaluation problem is one of the most interesting unsolved problems in enterprise software right now.
  • You want to own a roadmap that is genuinely consequential, not increment on features that already exist.
  • Are the kind of PM who would rather have a sharp conversation about what we should not build than ship something that does not hold up. You are not scared of technical depth. You lean into it.

Want to learn more about HackerRank? Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.

HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. descriptionText:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

About The Role

HackerRank's goal is straightforward: to give companies a dependable way to evaluate whether a candidate can do the job. The previous model, which relied on test cases and code correctness, is becoming less reliable as candidates use AI assistants and produce work that requires deeper scrutiny.

The Evaluation team is rebuilding the underlying scoring system. This involves defining the new evaluation rubrics, determining how our models apply them consistently across thousands of candidates, working with enterprise clients to define good performance, and ensuring our methodology is fair and defensible.

Evaluation's trustworthiness is fundamental to HackerRank's business and its products. We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager to own this crucial charter.

What You Will Do



- Own the evaluation product roadmap: what gets built, in what order, and why, with a clear point of view on what the product needs to become over the next 12 to 18 months.
- Define what "good evaluation" means in product terms: the rubrics, scoring dimensions, bias safeguards, and consistency checks that enterprise customers will stake hiring decisions on.
- Work directly with ML engineers and AI researchers to translate methodology into shipped product. You are the connective tissue between research clarity and engineering execution.
- Talk to enterprise customers regularly. Understand how Goldman Sachs defines a strong candidate differently from how a startup does, and make sure the product can serve both.
- Build the feedback loops that let the evaluation system improve: how we capture when customers disagree with a score, what signals we surface to the ML team, and how we close the loop.
- Define and own the metrics that tell us whether evaluation quality is actually improving, not just whether we shipped something.

Who You Are



- You have 5 or more years of product experience, with meaningful time in a B2B or enterprise context where your work had to be defensible to sophisticated customers.
- You think rigorously about if the measures actually map to the outcomes. A PM who cannot tell the difference between a good metric and a vanity metric will not survive this role.
- You are comfortable with ambiguity in the problem definition. The answer to "what does good evaluation look like" does not exist yet. You need to want to find it, not wait for someone to hand it to you.
- You can hold your own in a technical conversation with ML engineers without needing to code. You understand enough about model behavior, evaluation pipelines, and data feedback loops to ask sharp questions.
- You communicate with precision. Crisp PRDs, sharp debate in design reviews, clear framing to customers and leadership. You do not hide behind vague language when the problem is hard.

Even better if you have



- Prior experience in assessment, ed-tech, talent tech, or any domain where you had to build products around subjective or qualitative evaluation.
- Exposure to fairness, bias, or compliance considerations in a product context.
- Experience building or working closely with ML-powered scoring or ranking systems.
- Track record of defining new product categories rather than iterating on established ones.

You will thrive if you



- Believe the evaluation problem is one of the most interesting unsolved problems in enterprise software right now. 
- You want to own a roadmap that is genuinely consequential, not increment on features that already exist. 
- Are the kind of PM who would rather have a sharp conversation about what we should not build than ship something that does not hold up. You are not scared of technical depth. You lean into it.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today

At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.

In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.

While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!

You need to be a HODLer of these

  • 4-6+ years of relevant product management experience
  • At least 1 year of experience in building and creating product strategy/roadmap.
  • Strong grasp of user centered design process
  • Well-rounded interpersonal skills, and experience interacting with diverse personalities
  • MBA degree from a tier 1/2 business school
  • Bachelo's degree in technology or engineering from a tier 1,/ school

You will be mining through these tasks

  • Role is at an intersection of Payments/Banking rails and Compliance and will need to work closely with senior product managers of these two squads.
  • Manage the focus area for Fund Sources (Banks, On-Ramp Partners), KYC, AML and overall on-ramp/off-ramp rails.
  • Create a roadmap for the enhancements / addition to the product portfolio based on extensive data crunching and clearly defined KPIs and objectives
  • Responsible for delivering critical projects with crucial timelines and significant business impact.
  • Managing and executing decisions about the high-level technical architecture, product processes / automation and UI/UX designs of the project
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across functions to understand the user problem and their needs and formulate achievable requirements for development teams
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth.
  • Person would be willing to write technical PRD’s and work with engineering team and design team and execute the product roadmap
  • The growth path for this role (APM / PM role) can be into a PM/ SPM in either core Payments or Compliance team, based on performance, need of the org and also choice of the candidate.
  • Candidates should have prior product experience in KYC funnels OR Payment Gateway OR Risk/AML. Working with 3P tools like Signzy/Karza OR banking partners is BIG PLUS.

Are you the one? Our missing block

  • You are knowledge-hungry when it comes to VDA and Web3, always eager to dive deeper and stay ahead in this evolving space.
  • The world of Web3 and VDA excites you, fueling your curiosity and driving you to explore new opportunities within this dynamic landscape.
  • You act like an owner, constantly striving for excellence, impact, and tangible results in everything you do.
  • You embrace a ‘We over Me’ mindset, growing individually while fostering the growth of those around you.
  • Change is your catalyst, igniting your passion to build and innovate.
  • You think outside the box, unbound by limitations or doubt, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Perks That Empower You

Our benefits are designed to make a lasting impact on your life, giving you the freedom to create a work-life balance that truly suits you.﻿﻿

  • Design Your Own Benefit: Tailor your perk package to fit your unique needs. Whether you’re eyeing a new gadget or welcoming a furry friend into your life, our flexible benefits ensure that you can prioritize what matters most to you.
  • Unlimited Wellness Leaves: We believe in the power of well-being. Take the time you need to recharge, knowing that your health is our priority. With unlimited wellness leaves, you can return refreshed, ready to build and grow.
  • Mental Wellness Support: Your mental health is as important as your professional growth. Benefit from access to health experts, free counseling sessions, monthly wellness workshops, and regular team outings, all designed to help you stay balanced and connected.
  • Bi-Weekly Learning Sessions: These sessions are more than just updates—they’re opportunities to fuel your growth. Stay ahead with the latest industry knowledge, sharpen your skills, and accelerate your career in an ever-evolving landscape.

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Principal Product Manager (Module Lead) to own and scale one or more critical modules within the GreyMatter Multiagent Orchestration platform.

This role is ideal for a deeply technical product leader who thrives in complex distributed systems environments. You will not own the entire platform strategy globally — instead, you will take complete end-to-end ownership of specific high-impact modules

You will act as the product authority for your module(s), partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, and Global Product leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Module Ownership

  • Define and execute the roadmap for assigned GreyMatter modules.
  • Own feature prioritization, technical trade-offs, and release planning.
  • Ensure scalability, performance, and reliability at enterprise scale.

Technical Collaboration

  • Work hands-on with Engineering and Architecture teams on system design.
  • Contribute to discussions around distributed systems, latency constraints, real-time orchestration, and optimisation logic.
  • Ensure strong API-first, developer-friendly design principles.

AI & Optimisation Integration

  • Integrate AI/ML models into module workflows.
  • Drive continuous improvement through data feedback loops.
  • Partner with Data Science teams to productionize models in real-time environments.

Global Stakeholder Alignment

  • Work closely with US-based Product and Customer teams to align on roadmap priorities.
  • Translate field deployment feedback into product enhancements.
  • Support pre-sales conversations for module-specific deep dives when required.

Execution Leadership

  • Mentor and guide PMs or APMs within the module scope.
  • Drive clarity in PRDs, success metrics, and release outcomes.
  • Own module-level KPIs (performance, stability, adoption, customer impact).

Who You Are

Deep Technical Product Leader

You likely began in Engineering, Robotics, Systems, or Optimization before moving into Product. You are comfortable diving into algorithm complexity, distributed system trade-offs, and system bottlenecks.

Systems Thinker

You understand cloud-native architecture, real-time systems, and hardware-software integration. You can reason about scale, latency, and performance constraints.

Strong Executor

You can break complex platform problems into modular roadmaps and deliver iteratively without compromising long-term architecture integrity.

Cross-Functional Collaborator

You work effectively across time zones and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Requirements

  • Experience: 10+ years in Product Management or Technical Product roles. 5+ years working on platform, robotics, industrial AI, or deep-tech SaaS products. Experience owning complex distributed system modules
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of AI/ML workflows and real-time data systems. Experience with APIs, SDKs, and platform components. Exposure to optimization algorithms, multi-agent systems, or swarm intelligence is a strong plus
  • Leadership: Experience mentoring PMs or leading small product pods. Strong cross-functional execution experience

title: Sr. Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Providence

At Providence, we help people and communities’ benefit from the best health care model for the future—today. Providence Global Innovation Center (PGC) in India is part of Providence, one of the largest health systems in the US. We are a not-for-profit organization where every day, 119,000 compassionate caregivers serve patients and communities through a large network of 51 hospitals, 829 clinics and a comprehensive range of services across Alaska, California, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas and Washington. We believe that ‘health is a human right’ and our mission is to empower every person with access to affordable, quality and compassionate care. We deliver our vision - “Health for a Better World” by creating health systems of the future, building bridges for healthier communities, and providing clinical excellence by nurturing a spirit of innovation.

Data and AI (DnAI) organization in PGC focuses on creating intelligent products within Providence and provides unique opportunities in Product Development, Product Design, Data Engineering, Operations, Data Science, BI Reporting and Data Analytics on cloud stack. We are a group of professionals who work towards empowering stakeholders with insights that improve patient and caregiver experience

At DnAI, the discipline of Product Management is built around defining a clear, value-based product strategy and creating and managing a healthy roadmap, requiring team to work at the intersection of business, market and sector needs, technology and data analytics, customer and user expectations/ desires.

Job Requisition

We are seeking a seasoned Physician passionate about applying clinical expertise to build high‑impact healthcare analytics and AI‑driven solutions. This role focuses on reducing clinical abstraction burden and unlocking actionable insights that meaningfully improve care outcomes.This is a unique opportunity to directly influence how healthcare data and intelligence are used to improve efficiency, quality, and patient outcomes at scale.This role will shape contemporary healthcare solutions leveraging data and AI advances. The ideal candidate translates real‑world provider challenges into scalable analytics, partners closely with engineering and data science teams, and influences product strategy to ensure solutions are clinically grounded, compliant, and outcome‑driven.

Job Description

We're looking for an innovative and motivated Clinical Product Manager who will manage the multi-team development and operational delivery of portfolio of clinically valuable data products by working towards a data product vision that empowers caregivers with insights, understanding business requirements, managing changes, removing roadblocks, and communicating broadly with multiple functional groups and stakeholders.

The PM will oversee the ideation, planning and execution of the products and services, leveraging best-in class technology and systems; includes cloud computing, big data, mobile, data science, and modern software development methodologies and frameworks. He/She will partner with stakeholders across the business and product teams. The individual will be responsible for

  • Provide thought and execution leadership to incubate and ship clinical data products
  • Working with clinical users/customers and partners to shape clinically valuable product/platform vision and goals
  • Provide clinical insights during research, hypothesis and discovery phase for ideation and product development
  • Provide clinical knowledge during the R&D phase to data analytics and engineering teams during product development to curate MVP and ensure product performance meets intended uses.
  • Provide leadership for clinical verification and validation of new products, features, upgrades, and enhancements.
  • Working with engineers and architects as a bridge to translate clinical product requirements into business requirements to curate technical capabilities, features and technology required to meet the business requirements
  • Formulating US healthcare governance and compliance requirements in the context of product being developed
  • Understanding US healthcare trends and patterns, care models evolution and impacts to product roadmaps and plan for integration of relevant patterns into product roadmaps
  • Articulating features to customers to evangelize products and drive adoption
  • Feature prioritization and road map planning
  • Running design sprints & and user testing
  • Defining and tracking success metrics
  • Exploring new ways of improving existing services and products
  • Collaborating with and mentoring other product managers and product owners


Detailed Responsibilities

  • Envision products, create product roadmaps and ensure successful product increment launches by working with diverse stakeholders
  • Owning the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for the technical/data products, and be able to work autonomously
  • Translating problem, data & user research into developing innovative features & solutions.
  • Working nimbly across multiple projects, with fast-paced iterative product development cycles.
  • Setting priorities and managing any conflicts in priorities with stakeholders
  • Working with cross-functional teams to deliver a complete customer experience and make product release management successful.
  • Impressive verbal communication and presentation skills and at ease with business as well as technical audiences.
  • Articulating clear and concise product related documentation as well as general business communications.
  • Provide regular updates to leadership, escalating items when needed but with presence and relationships to identify and resolve most issues independently
  • Knowledgeably and successfully present our strategy, roadmap and current progress /actions to senior executive audiences inside the company
  • Foster, facilitate, and furnish, timely decision-making across a broad network of stakeholders, delivery partners, and operational teams.
  • Collaborate with security, architecture, engineering, quality, support, experience, program, and infrastructure partners in coordinating delivery of complex, multi-year initiatives
  • Accountability for team integrity, product excellence, decision making, delivery estimates and roadmaps and project outcomes.
  • The position is based in Hyderabad and requires flexible work shift schedule to accommodate North American time zone meetings.


Experience And Skills

  • MBBS or equivalent degree for clinical accreditation
  • 6+ years of Clinical experience
  • 6+ years of clinical solutions design experience, with 3+ years of active product management experience especially in curating clinically-anchored solutions and products.
  • Deep experience working with clinical technology products planning and implementation for problem scenarios in healthcare and life science domain is a critical capability.
  • Ability to operate in a startup mode, structure ambiguous, open-ended problems & analyzing data to discover user needs, most valuable use cases and curating product related insights.


Desired Skills/Experience

  • Experience in advanced engineering and design of modern cloud product development
  • Certifications in Product Management/Agile/Scrum.
  • Experience in User research, UX Prototyping.
  • Familiarity with modern solution stacks, frameworks
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA/Data Governance & Privacy would be considered a bonus.
  • Knowledge of US healthcare delivery models in will be considered a bonus


Skills

 Primary Skills

Clinical experience, EHR and EMR workflows, Clinical Workflows and care pathways, Clinical Product Management, Product Roadmap Development, Requirements Elicitation, User Research, Analysis and Journey Mapping, Business Case Development, Stakeholder Management, Technical Product Specs Authoring, UI/UX Prototyping

Sound understanding of any or all of following technical domains will be a plus: Data Analytics, Large and Small Language Models, AI & Cloud Computing Business Architectures (SaaS etc).

title: Lead/Group Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Noora Health India Private Limited is a key partner in Noora Health’s mission is to improve outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with the skills they need to care for their loved ones. They develop content, technology platforms, new products, and strengthen other operational functions that support the scale and impact of Noora Health’s programs.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 58 million caregivers and patients across 16,300+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

About The Role

The Mobile Care Companion (MCC) is Noora Health's primary digital touchpoint for family caregivers post discharge, serving ~50,000 users a day across India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal. It delivers behavior change and health system navigation at scale through two-way conversations, clinical triage, care coordination, and a growing set of AI-powered features.

This role owns MCC end-to-end: the caregiver experience, the health worker tools, the clinical workflows, and the AI layer that cuts across all of it. You will define what MCC becomes over the next three years, be accountable for both growth and outcomes, and lead an interdisciplinary team spanning product, clinical, data, and program functions to get there.

What You Will Do

  • Overall Model: Own the growth and operating model for MCC across user acquisition, activation, and retention at scale, including how MCC is positioned, priced, and deployed across government health systems and private partners
  • AI-led Product Experience: Reimagine the delivery with an AI-first thinking. Reason through where AI owns, where it assists, and where the experts jump in. Embed AI with an eval-led approach iterating to improve accuracy, engagement, and behavior change.
  • Product Roadmap: Set and execute the product roadmap to improve the user experience across the full funnel. Work with country program teams to translate local context (language, literacy, health system constraints) into product decisions that hold across four countries
  • Management & Execution: Deliver individually while also managing and mentoring a team of PMs, designers, clinicians across geographies.
  • Partnership & Advocacy: Represent the product with key internal and external stakeholders including health system partners, funders, leadership, and country teams to drive buy-in and unlock partnerships to drive MCC’s growth.

Who Are We Looking For

  • A 0-to-1 builder/founder: You have taken at least one product from concept to production to scale in a resource-constrained environment and owned its outcomes. You don't need scaffolding to get started
  • 6–12 years of product experience, with a meaningful share on AI-powered products; Hands-on fluency with LLMs: prompt design, retrieval architectures, eval pipelines, MCPs, and optimization workflows
  • Deeply data fluent and strong experimentation instinct: you obsesses about data, you define what good looks like before you build, and you are rigorous about measuring it
  • A first-principles thinker about complex service design. You are quick to build prototypes, sketch flows, write copies, and analyze and cut data to make your vision concrete
  • Able to work across clinical and technical teams, earn credibility with both, and translate between them clearly
  • Experience in healthcare, clinical tools, or other high-stakes domains is a strong plus

What We Value

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we understand the value of developing a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We prioritize diversity within our team, and we welcome candidates from all gender identities, castes, religious practices, sexual orientations, and abilities — among many others.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team in a Hybrid capacity, reporting to the Director, Product Management within the Product Management department. You will drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the Zscaler DSPM product line at the forefront of the world’s cloud security leader. By joining our team of innovation champions, you will deliver a growing portfolio of capabilities in threat prevention, visibility, and business enablement while shaping the future product roadmap.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead the vision and lifecycle for specific modules within the Zscaler DSPM suite, ensuring the roadmap is agile and aligned with Zscaler’s high-level business priorities and market trends
  • Translate complex market needs into detailed technical requirements, providing clear needs to Engg teams to build high-performance features meeting acceptance criteria
  • Partner with other teams to navigate the development lifecycle, removing roadblocks and adjusting requirements for timely delivery
  • Act as the subject matter expert by analyzing the competitive landscape, identifying growth opportunities, and neutralizing threats through informed, data-driven product pivots
  • Drive product adoption by collaborating with Marketing and Sales on GTM plans and engaging with customers for roadmap presentations, feedback loops, and high-level escalations


Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bridge the gap between technical and business audiences, communicating complex concepts to internal teams, executives, and customers
  • 3–5 years of dedicated experience in Enterprise Product Management, specifically within the Cybersecurity or Information Security domains
  • Proven experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and data classification products with understanding of legacy tools and modern AI-based classification methods
  • Deep knowledge of Cloud Security products (commercial and CSP-native) and unique security challenges inherent to cloud environments
  • Hands-on experience and technical working knowledge of at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)


What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Knowledge of Cloud Posture Security Management (CSPM), auto-remediation, activity analytics, cloud-native API’s, security frameworks and compliance standards
  • Technical degree or a background in hands-on engineering, providing the architectural depth needed to lead complex product modules
  • Prior success in roles such as Escalation Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Deployment Services


At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Benefits

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

  • Various health plans
  • Time off plans for vacation and sick time
  • Parental leave options
  • Retirement options
  • Education reimbursement
  • In-office perks, and more!


Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.

Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. See more information by clicking on the Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal link.

Pay Transparency

Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.

Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support.

title: Product Mgt Sr Manager-C13
descriptionHtml:
The Product Manager is an senior level position responsible for the development of product plans, strategies and tactics in coordination with the Product Management team. The overall objective of this role is to coordinate the promotion of products to develop new markets, increase share of market and obtain competitive position.

Responsibilities:

  • Requirements & User Story Definition: Worked closely with stakeholders to gather intricate requirements, translating them into well-defined user stories for agile scrum teams, ensuring clarity and alignment with technical capabilities.
  • Product Backlog & Release Management: Managed comprehensive product backlogs and prioritized releases by collaborating closely with business and stakeholders ensuring timely delivery of high-value features reflecting benefits in $$.
  • Developer Experience & Collaboration: Collaborated effectively with technology partners, CTI engineering and operations, and USPB core platform engineering teams to define and implement a unified and streamlined customer service experience.
  • Quality Assurance & Testing Liaison: Served as a primary liaison for Quality Engineers, clearly articulating testing requirements through Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and other acceptance criteria to ensure robust product quality.
  • Process & Governance Establishment: Maintained rigorous procedures, standards, and processes for Work Intake and backlog prioritization, enhancing operational efficiency and strategic alignment.
  • Strategic Initiative Tracking: Liaised with the Program Management Office, program managers, and business sponsors to meticulously track initiatives, clearly defining success criteria and ensuring alignment with broader business strategy and outcomes.
  • Communication Strategy & Stakeholder Engagement: Managed and researched effective communication strategies for internal and external stakeholders, disseminating information on upcoming releases, surveys, and product accomplishments.
  • Product Effectiveness & Feedback Loop: Tracked critical metrics and outcomes to demonstrate product effectiveness and established clear lines of sight to business impact, devising and implementing plans to gather continuous user feedback.
  • Learning & Development Support: Provided training and mentoring support for product owners and collaborated with learning management teams to identify and develop focused learning pathways, fostering continuous growth within the team.
  • Finalizes the project plan with stakeholders and track closely for successful project delivery.
  • Meets with end users to understand business needs, write requirements, conduct walk throughs on requirement documents
  • Reviews Functional Requirements to Business Requirements to ensure Technology has understood and met the end users’ needs/expectations.
  • Partners with Technology, Product and Operations Management Teams to prioritize delivery of key projects.
  • Masters strategic business process modeling, traceability and quality management techniques.
  • Applies best practices for effective communication and problem-solving.
  • Successfully compete for the most sought-after business analyst jobs.
  • Performs project Status reporting to Project Stakeholders, Product and Operations Partners.
  • Understand the bank environment and compliance and regulatory requirements.
  • Track actual project costs, identify variances, and reforecast project costs as needed.
  • Measure project management performance against standards.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to resolve business issues related to technology projects with significant business impact as well as share knowledge across product marketing, contributing to the development of new techniques and improvement of processes/workflow for the product marketing function
  • Participate in technology projects for small product enhancements and minor customizations
  • Serve as Subject Matter Expert (SME) on product customization projects and influence decisions through advice, counsel, and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization
  • Document new products and/or changes to existing products, ensure smooth business implementation during launch process, and prioritize and validate potentially dynamic material from multiple sources using analytical skills
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  • Owns requirement creation for given effort,
  • Leads scrum team deliverables, influences roadmap planning, etc, Project support, Discovery analysis, owns features,
  • Creates Epics, manages SCRUM team, Project Delivery, Intake Lead, INC/Issue Management, Product Discovery, release management
  • Ability to generate process Flows & Maps
  • Knowledge on Retail Cards Dispute application is preferable

Qualifications/ Skills :

  • 12-16 years or relevant experience ( Banking Domain, Retail / Cards experience is preferable / Fraud Dispute experience )
  • Knowledge of Pega application is preferable
  • Agile/Scrum Methodologies, Program Management, Cross-functional Coordination, Project Planning & Execution, Risk & Dependency Management, Stakeholder Management, JIRA.Deep knowledge of different Banking systems, theories, and practices relevant to a function
  • Technical Product Road mapping, Product Backlog Management, Release Planning & Prioritization, Journey Mapping, Product Strategy, TCO Optimization, Requirements Gathering, User Story Definition, Feedback Mechanisms.
  • Practical experience of multiple business cycles
  • Knowledge of industry and competitor products/services
  • Working knowledge of strategic direction of the function within the business as well as a solid conceptual/practical grounding in function and/or area of expertise
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated project management skills
  • Willing to work in night shifts

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Senior Product Manager (AI Product Management)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager

Full-Time | Product & Technology | Remote (India Only) / Hybrid

About The Role

AI/ML Experience Required Telephony Knowledge a Plus

We are building a cutting-edge platform that tests Generative AI-based Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems through real, automated phone calls — helping enterprises validate, benchmark, and improve their AI-powered voice experiences before they reach end customers. This is a high-impact space at the intersection of conversational AI, telephony, and quality engineering.

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end product lifecycle — from vision and strategy through discovery, delivery, and post-launch optimization. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, design, QA, sales, and marketing, and will play a pivotal role in shaping a product that sits at the forefront of AI-driven communication testing.

The ideal candidate has direct, hands-on experience managing AI/ML products and a strong intuition for how large language models and generative AI systems behave in production. Familiarity with telephony infrastructure and IVR systems will set you apart.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy & Vision

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Gen AI IVR testing platform, aligned with business goals.
  • Act as the voice of the customer while balancing long-term product scalability.
  • Monitor product performance using KPIs, analytics, and customer feedback to make data-driven decisions.

Discovery & Requirements

  • Gather, analyze, and prioritize requirements from clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders.
  • Translate customer needs and market insights around AI/ML and conversational voice systems into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Lead product discovery, validation, and feature definition using data and customer feedback.

title: Senior AI Product Manager (ID # 849)
descriptionHtml:
About the Company



SquadStack.ai is on a mission to transform the $450B global customer experience market. We’re building an AI-native, vertically integrated platform that combines AI agents, human agents, software and deep workflow orchestration to deliver sales & cx services-as-software at scale. If you’re excited about building products at the frontier of AI, voice, and platform abstraction—this is your playground.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Product Manager who’s equal parts strategist, builder, and visionary—someone who wants to shape the future of AI in customer experience. In this role, you’ll lead the development of our Voice AI platform and the go-to-market for our agentic voice AI. This is a high-ownership, zero-to-one opportunity to define product strategy, scale infrastructure, and empower developers and businesses to build with SquadStack’s AI capabilities.



Responsibilities



  • Product Strategy & Vision
  • Define and lead the roadmap for our Voice AI platform, aligning product initiatives with the company vision.
  • Work with leadership to translate abstract ideas into product strategy and modular platform offerings.
  • Stay ahead of trends in LLMs, agentic workflows, voice AI, and platform ecosystems.
  • Product Development & Execution
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, and data science to ship high-quality, high-leverage products.
  • Translate user needs into APIs, SDKs, and platform components that external teams can build on.
  • Lead the product lifecycle end-to-end—from problem discovery to post-launch iteration.
  • Go-to-Market & Ecosystem Building
  • Design a thoughtful GTM strategy with business teams: pricing, positioning, self-serve onboarding, and documentation.
  • Work closely with sales, marketing, and success to drive adoption across enterprises and SMEs.
  • Gather feedback from early adopters, devs, and internal users to iterate fast.
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Serve as the product bridge across internal teams (infra, sales, CX ops).
  • Evangelise platform thinking across the company—driving clarity on where we build vs expose.


  • Qualifications



    • 7-8 years of experience in product management, preferably in AI, SaaS, or PaaS.
    • Ex-Engineers or Technical/ Data Background (but now product-focused).
    • Understand AI-native or workflow orchestration products.
    • Have worked on extensible platforms or developer products.
    • Can marry infra thinking with product-led GTM, and build for both enterprise and SME/long-tail devs.
    • Clear, compelling communication—can explain complex concepts to both engineers and execs.


    Preferred Skills



    • Hands-on experience building or launching PaaS or workflow automation tools.
    • Founder or early-stage startup experience—bias for action and clarity under chaos.
    • Exposure to LLM tooling, voice AI, or agentic workflows.


    Pay range and compensation package



    Compensation: Competitive!



    Joining: ASAP!



    Location: Noida



    Equal Opportunity Statement



    Why join us? Build at the cutting edge of AI & CX. Work with a high-context team that values speed, clarity, and ambition. Influence not just product, but company direction—PMs become revenue drivers at our org. Competitive salary, ESOPs, and the opportunity to own a large surface area of impact.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Product Consultant: Adobe Learning Manager (LMS)

Overview:

As a Product Consultant for Adobe Learning Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful implementation and integration of our LMS solution – Adobe Learning Manager for our customers during onboarding. This role involves managing complex projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and providing expert guidance to clients to ensure their specific needs are met. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in LMS implementation, project management, and client relationship management.

What You’ll Do:

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage multiple LMS implementation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, and within scope.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, milestones, and risk management.
  • Conduct regular project status meetings with customers and internal teams to ensure alignment and address any issues promptly.

Customer Consultation:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers during the onboarding phase, providing expert advice and support.
  • Conduct thorough needs analysis to understand customer requirements and tailor LMS solutions to meet their specific needs.
  • Translate complex technical information for customers, ensuring they understand and can effectively use the system.
  • Facilitate customer training sessions and workshops to ensure successful adoption and utilization of Learning Manager.

Technical Expertise:

  • Implement configuration, customization, and integration of Adobe Learning Manager with other customer systems.
  • Help customers set up SSO, Out-of-the-box and API integrations.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to prioritize and resolve any roadblocks to implementation.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Create detailed implementation documentation, including project plans, configuration guides, and training materials.
  • Prepare regular project reports and presentations for customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of all project activities, issues, and resolutions.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in LMS implementation and e-learning technologies.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of implementation methodologies and processes.
  • Mentor and support junior implementation consultants, providing guidance and knowledge sharing.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Education Technology, or a related field.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 11 years of experience in implementing Learning Management Systems or similar SAAS-based solutions.
  • Proven track record of managing and delivering complex projects successfully.
  • Strong technical background with experience in system integration, data migration, and configuration.

Skills:

  • Strong Technical skills in the areas of SSO, API and Integrations with SAAS Products
  • Flair for AI and experience in using Gen AI is required.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong customer relationships.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in LMS platforms, e-learning standards (e.g., SCORM, xAPI), and related technologies.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Progression Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Description

As a Senior Product Manager on the Lifecycle Experiences team, you will own the product vision and execution roadmap for our Progression Intelligence charter. This charter sits at the intersection of machine learning, real-time decisioning, and customer lifecycle strategy - and is responsible for determining which customers to engage, with what action, at what moment, and through which channel.

You will lead the technical integration of our rewards optimization, causal measurement, and action intelligence systems onto a unified agentic orchestration platform - enabling faster experimentation, more personalized interventions, and greater operational efficiency across all our emerging locales.

This is a deeply technical role that requires equal comfort with ML systems, API architecture, and product strategy. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, and marketing stakeholders to ship systems that directly delight millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the multi-year product roadmap for Progression Intelligence, including the phased migration of core ML models and decisioning systems onto a unified orchestration platform
  • Define technical requirements and integration specifications for connecting rewards optimization, propensity modeling, causal incrementality measurement, and promotion configuration systems into a cohesive, real-time decisioning layer
  • Partner with applied scientists to translate model outputs into actionable product features - including reward denomination optimization, next-best-action recommendations, and personalized campaign triggers
  • Drive quarterly planning and prioritization across a portfolio of integrations, balancing technical debt, engineering capacity, and business impact
  • Define and own success metrics for the Progression Intelligence platform - including model coverage, decisioning latency, incremental lift, and customer settlement outcomes
  • Write product requirement documents and participate in technical design reviews, and lead alignment across engineering, science, and business stakeholders
  • Represent the Progression Intelligence charter in senior leadership reviews, including weekly business reviews and annual planning cycles
  • Identify and resolve technical dependencies and cross-team blockers to keep the integration roadmap on track

About The Team

The Lifecycle Experiences team is on a mission to deepen customer engagement across Amazon's fastest-growing marketplaces. We own the end-to-end customer lifecycle - from first purchase to habitual shopping - across India, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Australia, Singapore, and South Africa. Our north star is moving customers from occasional buyers to loyal, high-frequency shoppers.

We build and scale programs including Gamified Experiences, Rewards, Promotions Orchestration, and Personalization - reaching millions of customers across our fast growing marketplaces. We operate at the intersection of product, marketing, and data science, and we move fast.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience owning technology products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
  • Master's degree or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
