title: Senior Product Manager – VialtoComp
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Vialto Partners is a market leader in Global Mobility Services. Our purpose is to “Connect the World.” We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.

Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 8,000 staff worldwide and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Job Description

The Senior Product Manager – AI‑Driven Compensation & Payroll plays a pivotal role in shaping and scaling VialtoComp’s next generation of digital compensation and payroll experience. This role drives product strategy and delivery across AI‑enabled solutions that support complex, global compensation and payroll journeys for multinational clients and their mobile workforces. 

Operating at the intersection of global mobility, compensation, payroll, and applied AI, the role partners closely with engineering, data, design, tax, payroll, equity, and client service teams. The focus is on intelligently automating complexity, improving accuracy, reducing risk, and delivering predictive, insight‑driven experiences across highly regulated environments. 

This role contributes directly to the VialtoComp product suite, positioning AI‑enabled compensation and payroll products as market‑leading platforms that enhance decision‑making, improve compliance, and deliver meaningful efficiency gains for both clients and internal delivery teams. 

Key Responsibilities 

Product Delivery & Operational Ownership 

 

  • Take ownership of defined compensation and payroll product areas or capabilities, operating within an established product vision and strategy. 
  • Manage day‑to‑day product execution, ensuring backlog items are clearly defined, prioritised, and delivered to a high standard. 
  • Translate operational requirements from payroll, mobility, tax, and client service teams into actionable product features. 
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet compliance, auditability, and regulatory constraints across jurisdictions. 
  • Act as a key point of coordination between product, engineering, and operational delivery teams. 

 

AI & Automation Enablement 

 

  • Partner with engineering and data teams to embed AI‑enabled and rules‑based automation into payroll and compensation processes, such as:  
  • Payroll data validation and reconciliation 
  • Compensation calculations and reporting support 
  • Error detection, exception handling, and workflow orchestration 
  • Support the safe adoption of AI by helping define:  
  • Operational guardrails and approval workflows 
  • Explainability and transparency requirements 
  • Human‑in‑the‑loop processes where required   

Continuous Improvement & Product Operations 

 

  • Monitor product usage, operational metrics, defects, and feedback to drive continuous improvement. 
  • Help define and track operational success measures, such as processing efficiency, error reduction, and cycle‑time improvements. 
  • Support response to regulatory change by coordinating product updates with SMEs and delivery teams. 
  • Contribute to improving product delivery practices, documentation, and ways of working within the product organization. 

 

Qualifications / Experience 

 

  • 4–6 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or product‑led delivery roles. 
  • Experience working on operational, regulated, or data‑intensive platforms, ideally in payroll, compensation, tax, finance, or HR technology. 
  • Strong ability to convert operational and regulatory requirements into clearly scoped product work. 
  • Experience working with automation and AI‑enabled tools, particularly where accuracy, auditability, and compliance are critical. 
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams. 
  • Comfortable working within an existing product strategy while improving delivery effectiveness and product quality. 

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve. To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

  • We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status.
  • Please note, AI is used as part of the application process.

title: Lead Product Manager, ITC
descriptionHtml:
Who You'll Work With

We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Manager to own and scale Nike’s Inventory Decision Platform for omnichannel fulfillment, a mission-critical capability to enable intelligent inventory forecasting and allocation decisions, demand-supply matching across channels and fulfilment node and optimised inventory utilisation,

As a Lead Product Manager working in the Supply Chain Planning technology team, you will operate at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Global Supply chain operations, driving the inventory decisioning platform at scale.

You Will Partner Closely With

  • Engineering and Data Science teams building optimisation and decision systems
  • Global & Geo Supply Chain teams managing inventory flow, allocation policies, and execution
  • Product, Architecture, and Data teams shaping the broader planning and inventory ecosystem
  • Business stakeholders across digital, retail, and fulfilment channels

You will act as the single point owner enabling the success of inventory decisioning products by aligning business priorities with technology strategy and execution.

Who We Are Looking For

  • 8–12 years of experience in Product Management and atleast 3+ years as a Product lead for Supply Chain domains
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, MBA preferred
  • Strong supply chain depth (inventory, planning, or fulfilment domains)
  • Experience working in global, cross-functional environments
  • Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence senior leaders
  • Ability to translate complex business problems into clear product direction
  • Data-driven mindset with focus on decisioning, trade-offs, and business outcomes
  • Clear and crisp communication adapted to technical and business audiences
  • Familiarity with supply chain forecasting / optimisation models or ML-driven decision systems
  • Nice to have exposure to packaged solutions like O9, Blue Yonder

What You'll Work On

As a Lead Product manager you will bring in

Inventory Decisions Domain Expertise

  • To drive omnichannel fulfilment capabilities across inventory forecasting, allocation, replenishment, visibility and deployment
  • Define decision logic for balancing: - Demand vs supply | Channel and marketplace priorities | Service levels, speed, and profitability
  • Enable dynamic decisioning using real-time signals, constraints, and optimisation logic
  • Partner with business teams to evolve policies, rules, and decision frameworks

Product Excellence

  • Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and delivery
  • Translate complex supply chain problems into scalable decisioning platform capabilities
  • Manage backlog, prioritisation, and execution with engineering and data science teams
  • Drive PI planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery tracking
  • Track value, adoption, and business impact (e.g., service levels, inventory utilisation, decision accuracy)

title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Shipment Technologies
descriptionHtml:
Description

Amazon’s Ship Tech (STS) team is responsible for key technology that enables planning, orchestration, and execution of transportation service to deliver billions of packages to Amazon.com customers globally. Our goal is to ensure the best delivery experience for customers across all geographies through a highly scalable, adaptive, and autonomous transportation network.

We are looking for a product leader to be a part of our multi-year effort to build the next generation of transportation planning and intelligence products. They will own critical Amazon services that leverage real-time insights and predictive supply chain data across our entire network to drive automation, efficiency, and visibility. These services allow us to identify problems that could impact on-time delivery, take proactive actions to mitigate network and package level problems, and keep customers informed on what is happening.

The ideal candidate is capable of breaking down and solving complex problems, and has a strong will to get things done! You will work on real world problems on a global scale. You own your products end-to-end and influence the direction of our product and technology which impacts hundreds-of-millions of customers around the world. You are a hands-on, pragmatic problem solver that easily balances trade-offs between competing interests. You thrive in a fast-moving team environment where you are able to juggle complex dependencies and requirements while producing optimal solutions.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as the subject matter expert in transportation and logistics, control towers, and workflow automation, leveraging your deep domain knowledge to identify market trends, customer pain points, and opportunities for product enhancement
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and customer success, to translate business requirements into technical specifications and drive the successful implementation of new product features and enhancements
  • Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with the company's overall strategic objectives and effectively communicates it to stakeholders
  • Continuously gather and analyze customer feedback, market intelligence, and industry insights to inform product decisions and ensure the delivery of high-value solutions
  • Manage the product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring that milestones are met, risks are mitigated, and the product is delivered on time and within budget

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of technical product or program management experience
  • Experience defining roadmap strategy and prioritizing deliverables for your team products
  • Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field or equivalent
  • Experience in transportation operations and industry knowledge
  • Experience understanding product and technical requirements and interfacing with Product/Technology teams
  • Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
  • Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams
  • Experience bringing technology products to market in a fast-paced environment
  • 6+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
  • Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
  • 5+ years of supply chain operations and logistics experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Product Leader Electrification
descriptionHtml:
Business Unit: EPSAutomotive Electronics

Role: Product Leader - Electrification

As a Product Leader – Electrification, you will own the strategy, technology roadmap and execution for our electrification product portfolio, mainly motor control units including inverters, motors etc. You will act as the strategic interface between OEM customers, engineering teams, and business leadership - shaping innovative, safe, and efficient solutions that accelerate the transition to sustainable mobility. This is a cross-functional leadership role that blends technical depth, customer engagement, and business strategy in a high-growth, fast-evolving domain.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Vision
  • Define and own the product strategy and technology roadmap for motor control units used in electric drive systems (eAxles, traction motors, hybrid drives) for India and global.
  • Analyze evolving EV architectures, regulations (emissions, homologation etc.), and OEM needs to guide feature prioritization.
  • Stay current with trends in e-motors, inverters, power electronics (SiC, GaN), and battery systems.
  • Collaborate with R&D teams on emerging technologies such as 800V architectures and thermal management optimization.
  • Analyze market trends, regulatory requirements (AIS, NCAP, ISO 26262, UNECE), and competitive products to guide feature prioritization.
  • Identify new business opportunities in ePowertrain and energy management solutions.
  • Develop clear value propositions and business cases for product investments.
  • Contribute to technology partnerships and innovation scouting.
  • Execution & Delivery
  • Translate user needs, customer/regulatroty/safety requirements into clear product goals and technology roadmaps & specifications.
  • Lead cross-functional teams (software, systems, hardware, validation) through the product lifecycle - from concept to SOP (Start of Production).
  • Prioritize features, manage trade-offs between performance, cost, and schedule.
  • Manage product lifecycle from concept through production and post-launch updates.
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Work closely with regulatory authorities, other tier1 stakeholders and internal stakeholders to align product goals and technology roadmaps.
  • Be the primary product interface to OEM customers - gather requirements, define specifications, and drive joint development programs.
  • Collaborate with sales and engineering teams to support RFQ (Request for Quotation) responses and define optimal product configurations.
  • Translate OEM requirements into clear internal product specifications and technical deliverables.
  • Collaborate with sales, engineering, and program management to ensure customer satisfaction and project success.
  • Present progress and outcomes to executive leadership and external partners.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and standards bodies.
  • Education
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering.
  • MBA or certification in Product Management is an advantage.
  • Experience
  • 15+ years of experience in automotive product management, program management or systems engineering, including at least 3–5 years in electrification or ePowertrain.
  • Proven experience managing OEM customer programs at a Tier 1 supplier.
  • Deep understanding of high-voltage systems, power electronics, and vehicle integration.
  • Familiarity with ASPICE, AUTOSAR, and model-based development (MBSE).
  • Strong leadership and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with business priorities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Finance Technology
descriptionHtml:
Description

Imagine being at the forefront of revolutionizing the tax industry with latest technologies. As a Product Manager – Technical in the FinTech Tax Technology team, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of tax products and solutions that empower businesses and individuals to navigate the ever-evolving landscape of tax regulations and compliance requirements.

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for driving the product strategy, technical roadmap, and delivery of our innovative tax product suite. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and subject matter experts, to translate complex tax requirements into robust, scalable, and secure software solutions and ensure our products meet the evolving needs of our customers and comply with complex tax regulations.

Join our team and be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization that values excellence, collaboration, and a passion for leveraging technology to simplify the complexities of tax.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager - Tech, you will lead new, large product initiatives to define the long-term strategy and vision to meet emerging customer needs and tax regulations. You will handle complex product development and business management scenarios, proactively identifying gaps/opportunities to then develop a suite of products to solve the problems.

  • Define product strategy, roadmap, and vision for tax product portfolio
  • Capture and translate complex tax requirements, regulations, and customer needs into technical specifications, user stories, and innovative user experiences

title: Principal Product Manager, CPN
descriptionHtml:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You'll Be Responsible For

You will define and drive the long-term product strategy for the CPN Payments Engine — the foundational infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across Circle’s global network.

You will operate as the end-to-end owner of payment execution across corridors and rails, shaping how the system evolves to support scale, resilience, and new financial use cases. This includes setting the vision for reliability, performance, and extensibility, and leading cross-functional efforts to translate that vision into measurable improvements in throughput, latency, and network success rates. You will also influence adjacent systems and partner integrations to ensure the Payments Engine operates as a cohesive, high-performing platform across the ecosystem.

Core Requirements

What you'll bring to Circle:

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure
  • Experience owning complex platform or infrastructure products such as payment engines, settlement systems, or distributed processing systems
  • Demonstrated ability to define and drive strategy for ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces with company-level implications
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to diagnose systemic issues in payment flows and drive data-informed decisions; proficiency with SQL or equivalent
  • Track record of delivering step-function improvements in system reliability, performance, or scalability
  • Experience influencing architecture and working deeply with Engineering on trade-offs and system design
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and external partners
  • Ability to operate seamlessly from strategic vision to hands-on execution, including writing detailed product and technical specifications
  • Clear and structured communicator, capable of aligning senior stakeholders and driving decision-making

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with global payments networks, settlement systems, or financial infrastructure (e.g., cross-border payments, correspondent banking, stablecoins)
  • Deep understanding of two-sided network dynamics and marketplace liquidity challenges
  • Experience building compliance-forward systems where regulatory requirements shape product and system design
  • Expertise in API product management for enterprise or developer-facing platforms
  • Familiarity with payment lifecycle events, failure taxonomy, and large-scale operational tooling for monitoring and exception handling

This role is based in our Bangalore office and requires employees to work from the office on a regular basis.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

title: Lead Product Manager Technical (Cloud)
descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Lead Product Manager Technical (Cloud)

Who is Mastercard

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible.

Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview

As a Lead Product Manager – Technical within Mastercard Services, you will lead end-to-end product development for complex, multi-team platform capabilities. You will turn business problems and product strategy into clear, structured requirements (initiatives, epics, features, and user stories) that enable engineering teams to deliver high-quality outcomes at scale.

This role partners closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture to drive clarity, prioritization, and delivery readiness across one or more domains.

Role

This position is a member of Services Enablement & Transformation Cloud Infrastructure team.

  • Define and execute cloud-native product strategy and multi-quarter roadmaps, translating business goals into scalable platform initiatives aligned with cross-team strategies.
  • Lead technical requirement clarification and solution discussions in partnership with engineering leads and architects.
  • Challenge designs or requirements where needed to improve quality, accelerate delivery, lower costs, and long term maintainability.
  • Document requirements clearly with rules, workflow diagrams or state transition tables to aid understanding
  • Own the definition and evolution of initiatives, epics, features, and user stories, ensuring requirements are complete, coherent, and aligned to product strategy and architectural direction.
  • Drive prioritisation decisions and trade offs at initiative, epic, and feature level, balancing scope, risk, value, and delivery constraints.
  • Partner with engineering leads to drive project planning and delivery coordination, including defining milestones/timelines, tracking progress, proactively managing risks and dependencies, and communicating delivery impacts or changes to stakeholders.
  • Step in where needed to maintain momentum, remove ambiguity, and ensure delivery alignment across multiple scrum teams.
  • Ensure vulnerabilities and mandatory technical imperatives for the product are handled timely
  • Own deliveries while ensuring proposed solutions meet all requirements and fit within Mastercard technology standards.


All About You

  • Strong experience leading technical product development from ideation through delivery across multiple teams.
  • Good understanding of cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern data platforms (e.g. distributed data processing, storage, analytics and AI/ML)
  • Proven ability to manage scope, prioritisation, and trade offs in complex product environments.
  • Comfortable working with engineers and architects on solution design, constraints, and delivery sequencing.
  • High-energy, detail-oriented and proactive with the ability to function under pressure in fast-paced, agile environment
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with strong relationship, collaborative and organization skills
  • Familiarity with formal product and delivery governance models (e.g. data privacy reviews, architecture reviews, delivery readiness).


Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Product Portfolio and Commercialization Leader
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary:

Manages key product line lifecycles. Understands and interprets market and industry trends. Leads the marketing initiatives for new product introduction and existing product change introduction.

Key Responsibilities:

  • New Product Commercialization: Achieve ≥100% AOP for new products, establish Product-Market Fit (PMF) within defined timelines, and drive early traction through structured campaigns and pipeline creation.
  • Sales Handover & Scale-Up: Ensure seamless transition of products to Sales with clear STP, zero ownership ambiguity, and defined scale readiness within agreed timelines.
  • Portfolio Performance Management: Deliver planned revenue and margins for legacy products through active 4P calibration, pricing actions, and continuous portfolio optimization.
  • Channel Capability & Governance: Build a high-performing partner ecosystem with structured performance tracking, active partner engagement, and clear actions for underperformance.
  • People & Process Excellence: Develop a strong NPL team, institutionalize commercialization playbooks, and drive a culture of repeatable, scalable execution through continuous learning and reviews.

Experience Required:

  • 10+ years of experience across B2B sales, Business Development, Product Commercialization, or Channel-led growth.
  • People leadership experience (5+ years) , managing and coaching mid-sized sales / BD teams with accountability for performance, capability building, and culture.
  • At least one considerable stint in direct customer-facing B2B/B2C sales roles.
  • Hands-on experience launching and scaling new products , owning initial revenue, early adopters, and structured handover to core sales teams.
  • End-to-end portfolio ownership experience , including pricing, margin management, SKU rationalization, and lifecycle optimization of legacy products.
  • Demonstrated capability in designing and executing early-market sales campaigns , demand generation initiatives, and pipeline creation post-launch.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance) to institutionalize commercialization playbooks.

Skills Requirement:

  • Sales Strategy & Early Market Execution – Skilled at creating focused campaigns, building initial pipelines, and closing first reference customers.
  • Portfolio & 4P Management (Product, Price, Place, Promotion) – Ability to continuously calibrate offerings based on market feedback and data.
  • Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Influence – Strong ability to align Sales, Marketing, and Product teams around commercialization priorities.
  • Process Orientation & Scalability Mindset – Ability to convert ad-hoc launches into repeatable, institutionalized commercialization processes.

Competencies:

Storytelling - Develops and delivers a compelling narrative which resonates with a target audience and influences a decision or course of action.

Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Strategic mindset - Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.

Articulating Value Proposition - Interprets internal and external customer needs based on relevant application; explains and demonstrates products, solutions, and services to distinguish strengths and weaknesses to meet customer's specific needs to differentiate against competition.

Marketing Plan Management - Develops marketing mix recommendations based on the 4 P’s (Product, Price, Promotion, and Placement) to meet customer needs and achieve business objectives; guides and influences cross-functional implementation and creates framework to evaluate market responses and business performance.

Maximizing Profitability - Develops strategies that demonstrate the use of all marketing and sales levers (e.g. pricing strategies, promotions, volume based incentives, and value, feature, or benefit selling) to optimize profit.

Positioning For Target Segments - Aggregates appropriate inputs (e.g. customer perceptions, competitor positioning, alternative product capabilities) and determining where we need or want to compete for business within the target market segment.

Product Life Cycle Management - Identifies and executes changes to the product portfolio in response to evolving market dynamics and customer needs

Translating Relevant Market Data - Collects and categorizes customer voices and market information by leveraging appropriate research tools and techniques; analyzes research findings to identify opportunities to deliver customer solutions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Marketing, Sales, technical, or a related subject required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:

Significant relevant work experience required, including supervisory experience.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (Search and AI)
descriptionHtml:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD95938

Position Overview

We are seeking a curious, data-driven, and strategic storyteller to join Autodesk data platform team. Autodesk design and make platform offerings are APIs, services, and an ecosystem marketplace that accelerates digital transformation and drives better results. As a Senior Technical Product Manager, for platform, you will be at the forefront to define and drive the next generation Knowledge & Information Retrieval Platform at Autodesk — powering AI-native, semantic, and agentic discovery experiences across Autodesk products and ecosystem.

These services are used by almost every Autodesk product enabling data discoverability experiences, next generation information retrieval paradigms, and agentic AI workflows across our platform ecosystem. In this role you’ll be leading and driving next gen AI enabled search experiences and underlying platform capabilities. You will build a roadmap which not only articulates technical investments but how it impacts business outcomes with a data-driven approach. You are an excellent communicator, story-teller, drives customer value through rapid prototyping and comfortable speaking with engineers as you are with senior executives.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Define and execute on a multi-year strategy and roadmap for Autodesk’s Knowledge Retrieval Platform, improving discoverability, relevance, and AI-readiness of platform data across products
  • Agentic Enablement - Define retrieval interfaces and APIs optimized for AI agents and copilots (access methods, standards, API design and SLOs)
  • Own & Track Quality Metrics - Define and track relevance, precision/recall, latency, freshness, and AI grounding metrics
  • Drive roadmap for advance AI powered search across structured data, unstructured docs, CAD models, and 3D assets
  • Develop and manage relationships with architecture, engineering, and product teams to deliver customer outcomes
  • Identify market opportunities in search space and guide platform search vision and strategy
  • Experience with rapid prototyping to showcase customer value through experiences
  • Manage product lifecycle, including product roadmap, release planning, and positioning
  • Work directly with Autodesk product teams and 3rd party developer ecosystem to define, prioritize, and plan development of new features and capabilities
  • Articulate platform value to customers and internal stakeholders while differentiating platform from competitive offerings
  • Lead GTM plans and beta programs

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of product management experience in platform or infrastructure products, including 4+ years in search, information retrieval, and AI-powered discovery systems
  • Strong knowledge of basic search technology such as indexing, query patterns, ranking and relevance systems
  • Deep familiarity with modern information retrieval systems including semantic/vector search, multi-modal, knowledge graphs, hybrid ranking systems, contextual personalization, and LLM-grounded retrieval architectures (RAG, GraphRAG)
  • Ability to articulate complex technical and business concepts in simply understood terms
  • Experience creating clear technical product requirement documents(PRDs)
  • Strong prioritization, relationship building, and organization skills with exceptional storytelling
  • Leading and influencing cross-functional teams, stakeholders and junior team members
  • Comfortable managing risk, and ambiguity
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with a global team and travel for work on occasion
  • BS Degree in Architecture, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Management or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficient in tools, technologies, and best practices used in search technology, particularly using Open Search or Elastic
  • Experience launching AI-native retrieval systems for AI copilots and agents, at scale
  • Experience with A/B testing and experimentation
  • Knowledge and familiarity with parametric BIM tools like Revit and managing large amounts of AEC and Manufacturing data
  • Experience applying industry standards (e.g., IFC, USD, 3DTiles, UK BIM standards etc.) to data would be a bonus
  • Familiarity with scrum/agile methodologies

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Diversity & Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/diversity-and-belonging

title: Senior Product Manager, Retail Business Services
descriptionHtml:
Description

Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) is a Senior Leadership Team mission to remove unnecessary costs and invent growth opportunities in Amazon's retail business. UDE requires a myriad of software and AI mechanisms. We're in search of a Sr. Product Manager to lead our human in the loop defect elimination artificial intelligence platform.

Retail Business Services (RBS) is the force multiplier team for Amazon’s Retail business growth worldwide through three core strategic initiatives: (1) Defect Elimination - identifying retail defects at their root cause and driving extirpation to increase margins; (2) Selection - enriching Amazon inventory data increasing gross sales; and, (3) Operational Excellence - to ensure Amazon's retail business is running efficiently and effectively.

The RBS Cost to Serve team works on an array of technologies ranging from automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of highly complex tasks to scaled out platform software. We're in beginning stages of building a horizontal internal platform complete with a front end interface to oversee our UDE program; and, we need an experienced Sr. Product Manager to lead product development.

As the Defect Elimination AI Platform Sr. Product Manager, you would manage the development life cycle of our nascent technology in partnership with both a Product Leader and Engineering team. The day-to-day responsibilities include, but are not limited authoring requirements documents; hands-on system validation; unblocking Dev team issues; ensuring teams are tracking to committed timelines; developing a road map; aligning with stakeholders; collaborating with partner teams; and ensuring a successful, on-time launch.

Work/Life Balance

RBS puts a high value on work-life harmony. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Also, we provide trainings to employees through online learning platforms and encourage employees to take up AWS/ML certifications.

Key job responsibilities

  • Experience of managing complex business processes at scale.
  • Drive end-to-end high impact and high visibility programs that impact WW Retail and hence customer experience on Amazon
  • Communication and influencing skills with an ability to deal with a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in defining, developing and using metrics to drive the vision and manage the business.
  • Analyze data and dive deep into processes to derive insights for enhancing systems
  • Ability to lead not only at the strategic level, but also tactically day-to-day by diving deeply into business and technical domains.
  • Liaise with tech, product, ops and category teams to ensure timely deliverables for key projects
  • Ability to work effectively & independently in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Write compelling business documents and drive outcomes for senior leadership at Amazon

A day in the life

  • Collaborating with cross-team stakeholders
  • Extracting requirements and authoring technical feature documents
  • Aligning with Engineering counterparts to ensure development is done to specification
  • Driving meetings to impactful conclusions
  • Product advocacy communications
  • Daily adherence to Amazon's Leadership Principles

About The Team

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience owning technology products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
  • Experience in delivering end-to-end customer research studies, including study design, fieldwork (qualitative research moderation and survey execution), analysis, recommendations, reporting and presentation of results to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Product Manager

Experience: 6–10 years

Location: Bangalore – Work From Office (WFO)


About Aerchain (Why Us?)

We're rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI-first platform that powers $20B+ in enterprise spend. From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise-grade, AI-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.


Role Snapshot

You'll own a cluster of modules and be accountable for the outcomes they drive across customers. You'll work with enterprise clients to ensure they realise value from the product, lead solutioning for complex accounts, define what the cluster builds and why, and ensure every module delivers measurable customer value. You'll work across business, engineering, and leadership — and develop the PMs and APMs in your cluster. You report to the Product Lead.


What You’ll Drive

Problem Discovery & Research

  • Drive discovery across the cluster — understand customer problems, workflows, and success criteria at the deepest level.
  • Set the standard for how problems are diagnosed and sized across your PMs. Challenge recommendations, not just review them.
  • Zero escalations without a fully formed recommendation and reasoning.


Customer Ownership

  • Own Tier A customer engagements end-to-end — from understanding their problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
  • Solution enterprise clients independently, coordinating with PMs where modules overlap.
  • Be the single point of contact for Tier A customers — through delivery, adoption, and outcome validation.


Solutioning & Prototyping

  • Own the cluster roadmap — what gets built, deferred, and killed across all modules, with reasoning tied to customer outcomes.
  • Sign off on PRDs and prototypes from your PMs. Not as an approval gate — as the person who knows the modules well enough to find what's missing.
  • Use AI across every step — research, problem framing, drafting, prototyping, validation. Set the standard for the cluster.


Execution & Delivery

  • Oversee delivery across the cluster. Sign off on sprint plans and ensure PMs are unblocked and on track.
  • Own the quality bar across all modules. A delivery failure in the cluster is your failure.


Release & Adoption

  • Hold the customer-value metrics standard across all modules in the cluster. PMs define — you challenge and validate.
  • Own post-release outcomes for Tier A customers. Stay in the loop until value is confirmed.
  • Develop PMs and APMs in your cluster — build their judgment, not just their output.


You’ll thrive here if

  • 6–10 years in product roles with clear progression from feature ownership to module or product area ownership.
  • You diagnose complex, ambiguous problems and make high-stakes calls with confidence — not just for yourself, but to set the standard for your team.
  • You use AI as a core part of how you work and raise the bar for those around you.
  • You develop people by doing — you show PMs and APMs what good looks like, not just tell them.
  • You own outcomes, not activities. You stay in the loop until value is confirmed, not until the feature ships.
  • Bonus: exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex B2B environments, or procurement tech.


What’s In It For You

  • Cluster-level ownership with full authority over what gets built and why.
  • Work with enterprise clients on problems that matter — and stay accountable until value is confirmed.
  • A direct line to the Product Lead with no bureaucracy between your judgment and the decisions that matter.
  • A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded — and the opposite is called out.


Ready to build Aerchain’s future?

If reimagining business engines with AI and solving problems at scale excites you, let's talk.

Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

title: Sr. Product Manager – Tech, Alexa Daily Essentials
descriptionHtml:
Description

Want to transform the way people interact with Alexa leveraging generative AI? Come join the team that is building the next-generation AI-assistant that gets things done across Timers, Alarms, Reminders, Calendars, Recipes, and News on Alexa devices. In this role, you'll drive product strategy and initiatives for a dedicated area within our Alexa Productivity Essentials team focused on driving engaging, high-traffic productivity scenarios for millions of customers worldwide. You’ll work with CX, science and engineering partners to build our next phase in making Alexa the world’s best personal assistant. The role presents an enormous opportunity to impact the customer experience for products that are used every day by people you know. We are looking for someone who is passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, has demonstrated product leadership skills, and thrives in an environment where they collaborate closely with colleagues across product, design, research, science and engineering.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive the architectural and platform vision for the product space
  • Own the roadmap and translate customer requirement into technical specifications
  • Collaborate closely with developers and engineering managers to drive and prioritize the roadmaps and make technical decisions and tradeoffs connected to your product space
  • Recognize and scope new customer opportunities, translating customer needs into business and system requirements
  • Drive project schedules from design to launch
  • Make the right trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
  • Clearly communicate goals, metrics, roles, and responsibilities to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work with senior leaders within Alexa and throughout Amazon

A day in the life

You will own part of the Alexa Productivity Essentials initiative, defining the vision, strategy, product and tech roadmap across experiences loved and used by millions of customers. You will work closely with science, design, research and engineering partners to craft experiences to help customers more seamlessly get more done, and translate that vision into a product roadmap. You will also partner with product teams across Alexa to define how our experiences leverage new innovations in generative AI to help customers accomplish their goals. This is a “Think Big” role where you get to craft the vision and strategy for how customers experience our features across a range of Alexa touch-points.

About The Team

We’re a collaborative team that works closely together, fostering a creative and fun dynamic. We build Alexa experiences that customers connect with on a daily basis, connecting to the essential services that become part of their daily rhythm. The ideal candidate for this role will possess a strong product background with a penchant for cross-team collaboration across business, technical, and design counterparts. They will have deep technical skills and customer centric mindset with a history of launching notable products.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Master's degree in a technical field, or Master of Business Administration
  • Experience working directly with engineering teams
  • Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
  • Previous experience building products that leverage A.I., Machine Learning, Speech/Natural Language Understanding

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. -  Own the roadmap and translate customer requirement into technical specifications
-  Collaborate closely with developers and engineering managers to drive and prioritize the roadmaps and make technical decisions and tradeoffs connected to your product space
-  Recognize and scope new customer opportunities, translating customer needs into business and system requirements
-  Drive project schedules from design to launch
-  Make the right trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
-  Clearly communicate goals, metrics, roles, and responsibilities to internal and external stakeholders
-  Work with senior leaders within Alexa and throughout Amazon

A day in the life

You will own part of the Alexa Productivity Essentials initiative, defining the vision, strategy, product and tech roadmap across experiences loved and used by millions of customers. You will work closely with science, design, research and engineering partners to craft experiences to help customers more seamlessly get more done, and translate that vision into a product roadmap. You will also partner with product teams across Alexa to define how our experiences leverage new innovations in generative AI to help customers accomplish their goals. This is a “Think Big” role where you get to craft the vision and strategy for how customers experience our features across a range of Alexa touch-points.

We’re a collaborative team that works closely together, fostering a creative and fun dynamic. We build Alexa experiences that customers connect with on a daily basis, connecting to the essential services that become part of their daily rhythm. The ideal candidate for this role will possess a strong product background with a penchant for cross-team collaboration across business, technical, and design counterparts. -  5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

-  Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

-  Experience with end to end product delivery
-  Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
-  Experience managing technical products or online services
-  Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

-  Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

title: Product Lead - JLG
descriptionHtml:
Job Requirements

Role/ Job Title: Product Lead – JLG

Business: JLG

Function/ Department: JLG

Job Purpose

To lead and anchor the end-to-end technology charter and customer journey for the JLG lending business, driving robust, scalable, and future-ready platforms across the loan lifecycle. The role will play a critical part in enabling seamless credit access for underserved segments, thereby contributing to the Bank’s financial inclusion agenda.

The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring efficient on-ground execution through technology, strong governance frameworks, and continuous innovation, while delivering a differentiated and scalable customer experience.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Own and strategically drive the end‑to‑end technology ecosystem for JLG lending, ensuring enterprise‑grade availability, scalability, resilience, and performance
  • Lead the conceptualization, design, and large‑scale rollout of integrated digital journeys across sourcing, onboarding, underwriting, disbursement, servicing, and collections
  • Architect and govern seamless enterprise integrations with core banking systems, credit bureaus, payment platforms, and multiple third‑party ecosystems
  • Partner deeply with business, field, and on‑ground teams to institutionalize highly efficient, scalable, and field‑aligned processes that enable rapid growth
  • Collaborate closely with product, risk, operations, compliance, and audit functions to deliver robust, compliant, and audit‑ready technology solutions
  • Strengthen data foundations, reporting frameworks, and portfolio monitoring capabilities, enabling proactive decision‑making and sustainable portfolio growth
  • Ensure uncompromising adherence to regulatory requirements, audit findings, and information security standards across all platforms and integrations
  • Champion continuous improvement and structured innovation, driving measurable gains in turnaround time, productivity, field efficiency, and customer experience at scale

Managerial & Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach senior team members to foster a culture of customer centricity, innovation, compliance, and integrity.
  • Create an environment focused on automation and digital enablement to meet customer needs holistically.
  • Strong expertise in lending architecture and enterprise integrations, with demonstrated success in field enablement, cross‑functional execution, stakeholder governance, and continuous improvement . Prior experience in microfinance, JLG, or rural lending ecosystems preferred

Educational Qualification:

Graduate/Postgraduate

Experience:

6+ years of experience in banking or financial services technology, with exposure to lending platforms

title: Senior Technical Product Manager I – E-Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bengaluru, India

Department: Global Data | E-Commerce Platform

Jeppesen ForeFlight is the industry leader in aviation software and data, serving commercial airlines, military operators, business aviation, and general aviation pilots worldwide. We are seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager based in Bengaluru to own the technical execution of our e-commerce platform as the primary product interface between engineering teams in India and global business stakeholders.

This role is a technical bridge connecting engineering teams in India with the broader roadmap and strategic direction set by global leadership. It is not a partnership with a US-based Product Manager as previously scoped — this candidate owns and drives technical execution autonomously. You will translate high-level strategy and business requirements into scalable, reliable, and high-quality technical solutions, working closely with engineering, architecture, and QA teams to deliver measurable outcomes for our customers and business.

Position Responsibilities

  • Own the technical product execution for the e-commerce platform, from requirements definition through delivery and iteration.
  • Translate product strategy and global business requirements into clear technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Serve as the primary product interface for engineering, architecture, and QA teams based in India.
  • Drive backlog grooming, sprint planning, and release readiness in collaboration with engineering leadership.
  • Ensure platform solutions meet requirements for scalability, performance, security, and reliability.
  • Make trade-off decisions related to technical complexity, timelines, and product quality.
  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early and proactively propose mitigation plans.
  • Support integration with payment systems, order management, fulfillment, and third-party services.
  • Use data, logs, and operational metrics to inform product improvements and prioritize enhancements.
  • Operate effectively across time zones, maintaining strong communication and documentation practices.


Basic Qualifications (required)

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • At least 4 years of experience in software-based product management.
  • Background in leading technical development; background in software engineering strongly preferred.
  • Experience delivering e-commerce platforms or large-scale transactional systems.
  • Experience translating high-level strategy into detailed, execution-ready requirements.
  • Excellent listening, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to work effectively with a global team.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with a high level of autonomy with minimal oversight.
  • Ability to balance speed, quality, and technical rigor in a fast-moving environment.


Preferred Qualifications (desired)

  • Experience with payment gateways, subscription billing, or digital product delivery platforms.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and API-driven integration patterns.
  • Experience operating as a technical PM across distributed, cross-timezone engineering teams.


Typical Education & Experience

Education/experience typically acquired through a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, and typically 4 or more years' related product management experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Why You Should Join

Benefits

At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we know you want a rewarding career. To do that, you need challenging projects, a good work environment, and awesome coworkers. We believe in our employees and empower them to make a direct impact on our products and services messaging. We strive to provide employees and their loved ones with a world-class benefits experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional well-being. Our benefits package includes but is not limited to the following:

  • Group Medical insurance
  • Group term life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance
  • Gym reimbursement
  • 20 days of paid vacation time
  • 12 days of paid sick time
  • Employee Assistance Program

title: Sr. Product Manager - AI Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager – AI Platform to build the foundational capabilities that enable HighLevel teams to ship AI-powered features faster and more reliably. This role is ideal for technical product managers or builder PMs who enjoy systems thinking and platform design. You will define and build internal AI infrastructure such as agent frameworks, model orchestration, evaluation systems, and data pipelines while ensuring these systems are reliable, scalable, and easy for product teams to use.

What You’ll Do

 AI Platform Strategy

  • Define the roadmap for HighLevel’s AI platform layer.
  • Identify core AI primitives that should be centralized across the company.
  • Ensure platform capabilities enable teams to ship AI features faster.

AI Infrastructure & Capabilities

Design and evolve platform systems including:

  • LLM and model orchestration
  • Agent frameworks and tool usage
  • Context and data pipelines
  • AI evaluation and monitoring
  • Guardrails and governance frameworks

Internal Developer Enablement

  • Build tools and abstractions that simplify AI development for product teams.
  • Provide documentation and reusable building blocks.
  • Reduce duplicated effort across teams.

Reliability, Performance & Cost

  • Define performance and reliability standards for AI systems.
  • Work with engineering to optimize inference latency, cost, and scalability.

Responsible AI & Governance

  • Embed safety, compliance, and transparency into AI platform design.
  • Partner with security and legal teams on governance frameworks.

What Success Looks Like

  • Product teams can ship AI features faster
  • Reduced duplication of AI infrastructure
  • Reliable and scalable AI platform services
  • Consistent AI output quality across products

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of product management experience
  • Experience working on technical platforms or developer infrastructure
  • Strong understanding of AI systems and LLM architectures
  • Ability to operate independently with high ownership

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on coding or AI prototyping experience (1–2+ years)
  • Experience building AI platforms, ML infrastructure, or developer tools
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks, vector databases, and evaluation systems

Who This Role Is For

  • Technical PMs who enjoy building foundational systems.
  • Builders who work closely with engineering and architecture.
  • Product managers comfortable prototyping ideas and validating solutions quickly.

Why Should You Join Us?

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

Equal Employment Opportunity Information

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

 JOB DESCRIPTION

SBI Card is a leading pure-play credit card issuer in India, offering a wide range of credit cards to cater to diverse customer needs. We are constantly innovating to meet the evolving financial needs of our customers, empowering them with digital currency for seamless payment experience and indulge in rewarding benefits. At SBI Card, the motto 'Make Life Simple' inspires every initiative, ensuring that customer convenience is at the forefront of all that we do. We are committed to building an environment where people can thrive and create a better future for everyone.

SBI Card is proud to be an equal opportunity & inclusive employer and welcome employees without any discrimination on the grounds of race, colour, gender, religion, creed, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, caste etc. SBI Card is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees are treated equally with dignity and respect which makes it a promising place to work.

Join us to shape the future of digital payment in India and unlock your full potential.

What’s In It For YOU

  • SBI Card truly lives by the work-life balance philosophy. We offer a robust wellness and wellbeing program to support mental and physical health of our employees
  • Admirable work deserves to be rewarded. We have a well curated bouquet of rewards and recognition program for the employees
  • Dynamic, Inclusive and Diverse team culture
  • Gender Neutral Policy
  • Inclusive Health Benefits for all - Medical Insurance, Personal Accidental, Group Term Life Insurance and Annual Health Checkup, Dental and OPD benefits
  • Commitment to the overall development of an employee through comprehensive learning & development framework

Role Purpose

The position is responsible for the end-to-end product lifecycle management of assigned cobrand products - from product design, launch and product enhancements.

Role Accountability

Product Manager

The product manager would be the "CEO of the product". Like a CEO, the Cobrand Product Manager would set the goals, define success, help motivate teams & would be responsible for the outcome.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complete life cycle of assigned cobrand product including launch & set up of new products
  • Lead P&L for allocated products in the portfolio & ensuring product profitability
  • Assess the needs of cardholders, Study market relevance for products, Conduct competitive analysis to identify opportunities & threats and make appropriate changes to the features of assigned products
  • Work with cobrand partners and collaborate with sales team to grow new accounts. Leverage partner relationships to get exclusive portfolio driven offers to increase customer engagement
  • Monitor adherence to budgets and key product metrics. Actively participate in internal and external audits
  • Work closely with the Customer Services team to reduce customer complaints and work towards continuous improvement in customer satisfaction
  • Scan market on Payment Innovations in the financial services Industry and ability to anticipate impact on card industry

Measures of Success

  • New account targets
  • Value Proposition Budget Management
  • Complaint Management
  • Product P&L Management
  • Product & Relationship Management, facilitate new customer acquisition by aiding Sales team with Marketing support
  • Process Adherence as per MOU

Technical Skills / Experience / Certifications

  • Understanding of product P&Ls and impact of various metrics/parameters on the bottom-line
  • Knowledge on Consumer and Competition behavior and Credit Card Market Dynamics

Competencies critical to the role

  • Problem solving
  • Analytical skills
  • Functional Acumen
  • Building Relationship
  • Teamwork & Collaboration
  • Negotiation skill

Qualification

MBA

Preferred Industry

Experience in financial services, Credit card industry is preferrable
